create or replace view public._src_avg_kpis as
 WITH g AS (
         SELECT sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.vendas) AS v,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.unidades) AS un,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.pedidos_itens) AS ped,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.pedidos) AS ped_reais,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.sessoes) AS ses,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.buybox_pct * vw_amazon_geral_dia.pageviews) / NULLIF(sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.pageviews), 0::numeric) AS bb,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.unidades_devolvidas) AS dev
           FROM vw_amazon_geral_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_geral_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31) AND NOT vw_amazon_geral_dia.em_consolidacao
        ), a AS (
         SELECT sum(vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia.cost) AS c
           FROM vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31)
        ), ff AS (
         SELECT sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) FILTER (WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Amazon'::text) AS fba,
            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) FILTER (WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Merchant'::text) AS fbm,
            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) AS tot
           FROM fact_amazon_pedido
          WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31) AND fact_amazon_pedido.order_status <> 'Cancelled'::text
        ), b AS (
         SELECT g.v,
            g.un,
            g.ped,
            g.ped_reais,
            g.ses,
            g.bb,
            g.dev,
            a.c AS ads,
            ff.fba,
            ff.fbm,
            ff.tot,
            round(g.v / NULLIF(a.c, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_total,
            round(100::numeric * a.c / NULLIF(g.v, 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos,
            round(100.0 * g.ped / NULLIF(g.ses, 0::numeric), 1) AS conv,
            round(100.0 * g.dev / NULLIF(g.un, 0::numeric), 1) AS txdev,
            round(100::numeric * g.bb, 1) AS bbpct
           FROM g,
            a,
            ff
        )
 SELECT ord,
    metrica,
    valor,
    meta,
    sugestao
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS ord,
            'Vendas'::text AS metrica,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(b.v), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS valor,
            NULL::text AS meta,
            'Faturamento Amazon'::text AS sugestao
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 2,
            'Vendas FBA'::text AS text,
            ((('R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(b.fba), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text)) || ' ('::text) || round(100::numeric * b.fba / NULLIF(b.tot, 0::numeric))) || '%)'::text,
            NULL::text AS text,
            'Fulfillment by Amazon'::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 3,
            'Vendas FBM'::text AS text,
            ((('R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(b.fbm), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text)) || ' ('::text) || round(100::numeric * b.fbm / NULLIF(b.tot, 0::numeric))) || '%)'::text,
            NULL::text AS text,
            'Fulfillment by Merchant (proprio)'::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 4,
            'Unidades'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(b.un, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS replace,
            NULL::text AS text,
            ''::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 5,
            'Pedidos'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(b.ped_reais, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS replace,
            NULL::text AS text,
            'Pedido unico. "Itens de pedido" no periodo: '::text || replace(to_char(b.ped, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text)
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 6,
            'Sessoes'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(b.ses, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS replace,
            NULL::text AS text,
            'Trafego'::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 7,
            'Conversao'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(b.conv, 1), 'FM990.0'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) || '%'::text,
            NULL::text AS text,
            'Itens de pedido por sessao'::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 8,
            'Ticket medio'::text AS text,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(b.v / NULLIF(b.ped_reais, 0::numeric), 2), 'FM990.00'::text), '.'::text, ','::text),
            NULL::text AS text,
            'Faturamento por pedido'::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 9,
            'Buy Box'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(b.bbpct, 1), 'FM990.0'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) || '%'::text,
            NULL::text AS text,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.bbpct < 90::numeric THEN 'Buy box baixo: revisar preco/saude da conta'::text
                    ELSE 'Saudavel'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 10,
            'Taxa devolucao'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(b.txdev, 1), 'FM990.0'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) || '%'::text,
            NULL::text AS text,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.txdev > 5::numeric THEN 'Alta: revisar produtos com devolucao'::text
                    ELSE 'Ok'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 11,
            'Investimento ads'::text AS text,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(b.ads), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text),
            NULL::text AS text,
            'SP + SB'::text AS text
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 12,
            'ROAS Total'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(b.roas_total, 2), 'FM990.00'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) AS replace,
            '10'::text AS text,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.roas_total < 10::numeric THEN 'Abaixo da meta: cortar desperdicio em ads sem perder volume'::text
                    ELSE 'Dentro da meta'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM b
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 13,
            'TACoS'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(b.tacos, 1), 'FM990.0'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) || '%'::text,
            '10%'::text AS text,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.tacos > 10::numeric THEN 'Ads acima de 10% do faturamento'::text
                    ELSE 'Ok'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM b) t
  ORDER BY ord;

create or replace view public._src_google_produto_dia as
 WITH m AS (
         SELECT google_produto_metricas.data,
            google_produto_metricas.campaign_id,
            google_produto_metricas.product_item_id,
            sum(google_produto_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_produto_metricas.metrica = 'cost'::text) AS gasto,
            sum(google_produto_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_produto_metricas.metrica = 'impressions'::text) AS impressoes,
            sum(google_produto_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_produto_metricas.metrica = 'clicks'::text) AS cliques,
            sum(google_produto_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_produto_metricas.metrica = 'conversions'::text) AS conversoes,
            sum(google_produto_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_produto_metricas.metrica = 'conversions_value'::text) AS receita
           FROM google_produto_metricas
          GROUP BY google_produto_metricas.data, google_produto_metricas.campaign_id, google_produto_metricas.product_item_id
        )
 SELECT m.data,
    m.campaign_id,
    dc.campaign_name,
    dc.advertising_channel_type AS tipo,
    m.product_item_id,
    dp.product_title,
    dp.brand,
    COALESCE(m.gasto, 0::numeric) AS gasto,
    COALESCE(m.impressoes, 0::numeric) AS impressoes,
    COALESCE(m.cliques, 0::numeric) AS cliques,
    COALESCE(m.conversoes, 0::numeric) AS conversoes,
    COALESCE(m.receita, 0::numeric) AS receita,
    COALESCE(m.receita, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(m.gasto, 0::numeric) AS roas,
    m.gasto / NULLIF(m.cliques, 0::numeric) AS cpc,
    m.gasto / NULLIF(m.impressoes, 0::numeric) * 1000::numeric AS cpm,
    m.gasto / NULLIF(m.conversoes, 0::numeric) AS cpa,
    m.cliques / NULLIF(m.impressoes, 0::numeric) * 100::numeric AS ctr,
    m.conversoes / NULLIF(m.cliques, 0::numeric) * 100::numeric AS taxa_conversao
   FROM m
     LEFT JOIN dim_google_produto dp ON dp.product_item_id = m.product_item_id
     LEFT JOIN dim_google_campanha dc ON dc.campaign_id = m.campaign_id;

create or replace view public._src_google_termo_dia as

            google_termo_metricas.ad_group_id,

            sum(google_termo_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_termo_metricas.metrica = 'cost'::text) AS gasto,

            sum(google_termo_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_termo_metricas.metrica = 'clicks'::text) AS cliques,
            sum(google_termo_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_termo_metricas.metrica = 'conversions'::text) AS conversoes,
            sum(google_termo_metricas.valor) FILTER (WHERE google_termo_metricas.metrica = 'conversions_value'::text) AS receita
           FROM google_termo_metricas
          GROUP BY google_termo_metricas.data, google_termo_metricas.ad_group_id, google_termo_metricas.search_term
        )
 SELECT m.data,
    dg.campaign_id,
    dc.campaign_name,
    m.ad_group_id,
    dg.ad_group_name,
    m.search_term,
    COALESCE(m.gasto, 0::numeric) AS gasto,

    COALESCE(m.cliques, 0::numeric) AS cliques,
    COALESCE(m.conversoes, 0::numeric) AS conversoes,
    COALESCE(m.receita, 0::numeric) AS receita,
    COALESCE(m.receita, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(m.gasto, 0::numeric) AS roas,
    m.gasto / NULLIF(m.cliques, 0::numeric) AS cpc,
    m.cliques / NULLIF(m.impressoes, 0::numeric) * 100::numeric AS ctr
   FROM m
     LEFT JOIN dim_google_grupo dg ON dg.ad_group_id = m.ad_group_id
     LEFT JOIN dim_google_campanha dc ON dc.campaign_id = dg.campaign_id;

create or replace view public._src_item_conversao_dia as
 WITH vendas AS (
         SELECT r.data_venda AS data,
            r.item_id,
            sum(r.quantity) AS unidades,
            sum(r.unit_price * r.quantity::numeric) AS receita,
            count(DISTINCT r.pedido_id) AS pedidos
           FROM ml_pedido_item_rt r
          WHERE (r.pedido_id IN ( SELECT ml_pedido_rt.pedido_id
                   FROM ml_pedido_rt
                  WHERE ml_pedido_rt.status = 'paid'::text))
          GROUP BY r.data_venda, r.item_id
        UNION ALL
         SELECT i_1.data_venda AS data,
            i_1.item_id,
            sum(i_1.quantity) AS sum,
            sum(i_1.unit_price * i_1.quantity::numeric) AS sum,
            count(DISTINCT i_1.pedido_id) AS count
           FROM ml_pedido_item i_1
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM ml_pedido_item_rt r2
                  WHERE r2.pedido_id = i_1.pedido_id))
          GROUP BY i_1.data_venda, i_1.item_id
        ), vendas_ag AS (
         SELECT vendas.data,
            vendas.item_id,
            sum(vendas.unidades)::bigint AS unidades,
            sum(vendas.receita) AS receita,
            sum(vendas.pedidos)::bigint AS pedidos
           FROM vendas
          GROUP BY vendas.data, vendas.item_id
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(v.data, s.data) AS data,
    COALESCE(v.item_id, s.item_id) AS item_id,
    i.title,
    i.seller_sku,
    i.price,
    COALESCE(v.visitas, 0) AS visitas,
    COALESCE(s.unidades, 0::bigint) AS unidades_vendidas,
    COALESCE(s.receita, 0::numeric) AS receita,
    COALESCE(s.pedidos, 0::bigint) AS pedidos,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(v.visitas, 0) > 0 THEN round(100.0 * COALESCE(s.unidades, 0::bigint)::numeric / v.visitas::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS conversao_pct
   FROM ml_item_visitas_dia v
     FULL JOIN vendas_ag s ON s.item_id = v.item_id AND s.data = v.data
     LEFT JOIN ml_item i ON i.item_id = COALESCE(v.item_id, s.item_id);

create or replace view public._src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia as
 WITH cfg AS (
         SELECT config_atribuicao_site.inicio
           FROM config_atribuicao_site
          WHERE config_atribuicao_site.chave = 'shopify_ultimo_clique'::text
        ), u AS (
         SELECT vw_meta_anuncio_dia.data,
            'Meta'::text AS canal,
            vw_meta_anuncio_dia.objetivo AS tipo_raw,
            vw_meta_anuncio_dia.gasto,
            vw_meta_anuncio_dia.receita,
            vw_meta_anuncio_dia.impressoes,
            vw_meta_anuncio_dia.cliques
           FROM vw_meta_anuncio_dia
        UNION ALL
         SELECT vw_google_campanha_dia.data,
            'Google'::text AS text,
            vw_google_campanha_dia.tipo,
            vw_google_campanha_dia.gasto,
            vw_google_campanha_dia.receita,
            vw_google_campanha_dia.impressoes,
            vw_google_campanha_dia.cliques
           FROM vw_google_campanha_dia
        ), plat AS (
         SELECT u.data,
            u.canal,
            u.tipo_raw,
            sum(u.gasto) AS investimento,
            sum(u.receita) AS receita,
            sum(u.impressoes) AS impressoes,
            sum(u.cliques) AS cliques
           FROM u
          GROUP BY u.data, u.canal, u.tipo_raw
        ), shop AS (
         SELECT vw_site_venda_midia_dia.data,
            vw_site_venda_midia_dia.fonte AS canal,
            vw_site_venda_midia_dia.tipo_raw,
            sum(vw_site_venda_midia_dia.pedidos) AS pedidos,
            sum(vw_site_venda_midia_dia.receita) AS receita
           FROM vw_site_venda_midia_dia
          GROUP BY vw_site_venda_midia_dia.data, vw_site_venda_midia_dia.fonte, vw_site_venda_midia_dia.tipo_raw
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(p.data, s.data) AS data,
            COALESCE(p.canal, s.canal) AS canal,
            COALESCE(p.tipo_raw, s.tipo_raw) AS tipo_raw,
            COALESCE(p.investimento, 0::numeric) AS investimento,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(p.data, s.data) >= (( SELECT cfg.inicio
                       FROM cfg)) THEN COALESCE(s.receita, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE p.receita
                END AS receita,
            p.receita AS receita_plataforma,
            s.pedidos AS pedidos_shopify,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(p.data, s.data) >= (( SELECT cfg.inicio
                       FROM cfg)) THEN 'shopify'::text
                    ELSE 'plataforma'::text
                END AS base_receita,
            COALESCE(p.impressoes, 0::numeric) AS impressoes,
            COALESCE(p.cliques, 0::numeric) AS cliques
           FROM plat p
             FULL JOIN shop s ON s.data = p.data AND s.canal = p.canal AND NOT s.tipo_raw IS DISTINCT FROM p.tipo_raw
        )
 SELECT data,
    canal,
        CASE tipo_raw
            WHEN 'OUTCOME_SALES'::text THEN 'Vendas'::text
            WHEN 'OUTCOME_TRAFFIC'::text THEN 'Tr├ífego'::text
            WHEN 'OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT'::text THEN 'Engajamento'::text
            WHEN 'OUTCOME_AWARENESS'::text THEN 'Reconhecimento'::text
            WHEN 'OUTCOME_LEADS'::text THEN 'Leads'::text
            WHEN 'OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION'::text THEN 'Promo├º├úo de app'::text
            WHEN 'PERFORMANCE_MAX'::text THEN 'Performance Max'::text
            WHEN 'SEARCH'::text THEN 'Search'::text
            WHEN 'DEMAND_GEN'::text THEN 'Demand Gen'::text
            WHEN 'DISPLAY'::text THEN 'Display'::text
            WHEN 'VIDEO'::text THEN 'V├¡deo'::text
            WHEN 'SHOPPING'::text THEN 'Shopping'::text
            WHEN 'DISCOVERY'::text THEN 'Discovery'::text
            WHEN 'MULTI_CHANNEL'::text THEN 'Multicanal'::text
            WHEN 'LOCAL'::text THEN 'Local'::text
            WHEN 'SMART'::text THEN 'Smart'::text
            WHEN 'UTM_SEM_CAMPANHA'::text THEN 'UTM sem campanha'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(tipo_raw, ''::text), '(sem tipo)'::text)
        END AS tipo,
    tipo_raw,
    round(investimento, 2) AS investimento,
    round(receita, 2) AS receita,
    round(receita / NULLIF(investimento, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(investimento * 100::numeric / NULLIF(receita, 0::numeric), 2) AS acos,
    impressoes,
    cliques,
    round(receita_plataforma, 2) AS receita_plataforma,
    pedidos_shopify,
    base_receita
   FROM agg;

create or replace view public._src_site_produto_dia as
 SELECT date AS data,
    COALESCE(line_item__product_id, line_item__sku, line_item__name) AS produto_key,
    max(line_item__name) AS produto,
    max(line_item__sku) AS sku,
    count(DISTINCT order_id) AS pedidos,
    sum(line_item__quantity) AS unidades,
    round(sum(line_item__net_sales), 2) AS receita
   FROM stg_shopify_orders_item
  WHERE COALESCE(order_test, false) = false AND order_cancelled_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(line_item__product_id, line_item__sku, line_item__name) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date, (COALESCE(line_item__product_id, line_item__sku, line_item__name));

create or replace view public._src_vw_cliente_canais as
 SELECT cliente_chave,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    count(DISTINCT canal) AS canais,
    string_agg(DISTINCT canal, ' + '::text ORDER BY canal) AS quais_canais,
    min(data) AS primeira_compra,
    max(data) AS ultima_compra,
    max(data) - min(data) AS dias_entre_primeira_ultima,
    sum(COALESCE(valor, 0::numeric)) AS faturamento,
    round(avg(COALESCE(valor, 0::numeric)), 2) AS ticket_medio,
    max(uf) AS uf,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) > 1 THEN 'recomprador'::text
            ELSE 'unico'::text
        END AS perfil,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT canal) > 1 THEN 'multicanal'::text
            ELSE 'canal unico'::text
        END AS alcance,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT canal) > 1 THEN 'Cliente multicanal: ativar oferta cruzada'::text
            WHEN count(*) > 1 THEN 'Recomprador de canal unico: testar oferta em outro canal'::text
            ELSE 'Compra unica: foco em reativacao'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM fact_pedido_cliente f
  WHERE cliente_chave IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cliente_chave;

create or replace view public.rev_flow_resumo as
 WITH d AS (
         SELECT v.flow_id,
            ((h.content::jsonb -> 'resposta'::text) -> 'data'::text) -> 'attributes'::text AS at
           FROM rev_flow v
             JOIN net._http_response h ON h.id = v.req
          WHERE h.status_code = 200 AND length(h.content) >= 600
        )
 SELECT flow_id,
    at ->> 'name'::text AS nome,
    at ->> 'status'::text AS status,
    (((at -> 'definition'::text) -> 'triggers'::text) -> 0) ->> 'type'::text AS gat_tipo,
    (((at -> 'definition'::text) -> 'triggers'::text) -> 0) ->> 'id'::text AS gat_id,
    jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(((((at -> 'definition'::text) -> 'triggers'::text) -> 0) -> 'trigger_filter'::text) -> 'condition_groups'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) AS g_gatilho,
    COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(((at -> 'definition'::text) -> 'profile_filter'::text) -> 'condition_groups'::text), '-1'::integer) AS g_perfil,
    (at -> 'definition'::text) -> 'profile_filter'::text AS pf,
    (at -> 'definition'::text) -> 'actions'::text AS acoes
   FROM d;

create or replace view public.vw_aads_campanhas as
 SELECT ad_type AS tipo,
    "left"(campaign_name, 32) AS campanha,
    round(sum(cost)) AS invest,
    round(sum(sales_14d)) AS vendas,
    round(100.0 * sum(cost) / NULLIF(sum(sales_14d), 0::numeric), 1) AS acos,
    round(sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    sum(units_14d) AS unidades,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) < 4::numeric THEN 'Ineficiente: revisar segmentacao/lances ou reduzir (arrasta o TACoS do canal)'::text
            WHEN (sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) >= 10::numeric THEN 'Escalar: ROAS alto com espaco'::text
            ELSE 'Otimizar rumo ao ROAS Total 10'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia
  WHERE data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31)
  GROUP BY ad_type, campaign_name
  ORDER BY (round(sum(cost))) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_aads_keywords as
 SELECT "left"(keyword, 30) AS keyword,
    match_type,
    round(sum(cost)) AS invest,
    round(sum(sales_14d)) AS vendas,
    sum(clicks) AS cliques,
    round(100.0 * sum(cost) / NULLIF(sum(sales_14d), 0::numeric), 1) AS acos,
    round(sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(sales_14d) = 0::numeric AND sum(cost) > 20::numeric THEN ('NEGATIVAR: R$'::text || round(sum(cost))) || ' gastos SEM venda'::text
            WHEN (sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) < 3::numeric AND sum(cost) > 30::numeric THEN ('Reduzir/negativar (ROAS '::text || round(sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2)) || ')'::text
            WHEN (sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) >= 10::numeric THEN ('Escalar (ROAS '::text || round(sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2)) || ')'::text
            ELSE 'Monitorar'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM vw_amazon_ads_keyword_dia
  WHERE data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31)
  GROUP BY keyword, match_type
 HAVING sum(cost) > 0::numeric
  ORDER BY (round(sum(cost))) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_aads_matchtype as
 SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN match_type = ANY (ARRAY['BROAD'::text, 'PHRASE'::text, 'EXACT'::text]) THEN match_type
            ELSE 'Auto: '::text || keyword
        END AS tipo,
    round(sum(cost)) AS invest,
    round(sum(sales_14d)) AS vendas,
    round(sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * sum(cost) / NULLIF(sum(sales_14d), 0::numeric), 1) AS acos,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) < 5::numeric THEN 'ROAS baixo: baixar lances nos termos caros e negativar os ruins deste tipo'::text
            WHEN (sum(sales_14d) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) >= 7::numeric THEN 'Eficiente: espaco pra escalar'::text
            ELSE 'Otimizar (rumo ao ROAS Total 10)'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM vw_amazon_ads_keyword_dia
  WHERE data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31)
  GROUP BY (
        CASE
            WHEN match_type = ANY (ARRAY['BROAD'::text, 'PHRASE'::text, 'EXACT'::text]) THEN match_type

        )
 SELECT COALESCE(p.titulo, w.asin) AS produto,
    w.asin,
    w.sku,
    w.imp AS impressoes,
    w.cli AS cliques,

    round(w.vendas) AS vendas,

        END AS sugestao
   FROM w
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dim_amazon_produto.asin,
            max(dim_amazon_produto.titulo) AS titulo
           FROM dim_amazon_produto
          GROUP BY dim_amazon_produto.asin) p ON p.asin = w.asin
  ORDER BY w.invest DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_aads_segmentos as

                CASE

                    WHEN vw_amazon_ads_keyword_dia.keyword ~* 'soldiers'::text THEN '1 Marca'::text
                    WHEN lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM vw_amazon_ads_keyword_dia.keyword)) ~ '^(creatina|whey|prote[i├¡]na|suplementos?|pr[e├®][ -]?treino|amino[a├í]cidos?|bcaa|glutamina|cafeina|colageno)$'::text THEN '3 Generico amplo'::text
                    ELSE '2 Generico especifico'::text
                END AS seg,

           FROM vw_amazon_ads_keyword_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_ads_keyword_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31)

 SELECT seg AS segmento,

create or replace view public.vw_aanun_melhorar as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(vw_amazon_produto_dia.titulo, vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin) AS produto,
            vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin AS asin,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.vendas) AS v,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.unidades) AS un,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.sessoes) AS ses,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.pageviews) AS pv,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.pedidos_itens) AS ped,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.buybox_pct * vw_amazon_produto_dia.pageviews) / NULLIF(sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.pageviews), 0::numeric) AS bb
           FROM vw_amazon_produto_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_produto_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31) AND NOT vw_amazon_produto_dia.em_consolidacao
          GROUP BY (COALESCE(vw_amazon_produto_dia.titulo, vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin)), vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin
        ), ads AS (
         SELECT vw_amazon_ads_produto_dia.asin,
            sum(vw_amazon_ads_produto_dia.cost) AS adcost,
            sum(vw_amazon_ads_produto_dia.sales_14d) AS adsales
           FROM vw_amazon_ads_produto_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_ads_produto_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31)
          GROUP BY vw_amazon_ads_produto_dia.asin
        )
 SELECT "left"(p.produto, 40) AS anuncio,
    p.asin,
    round(p.v) AS faturamento,
    p.un AS unidades,
    p.ses AS sessoes,
    round(p.pv / NULLIF(p.ses, 0::numeric), 1) AS pv_por_sessao,
    round(100.0 * p.ped / NULLIF(p.ses, 0::numeric), 1) AS conversao_pct,
    round(100::numeric * p.bb, 1) AS buybox_pct,
    round(p.v / NULLIF(p.un, 0::numeric), 2) AS preco_medio,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(a.adcost, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(p.v, 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos_asin_pct,
    round(100.0 * a.adcost / NULLIF(a.adsales, 0::numeric), 1) AS acos_asin_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.v, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric AND p.ses > 0::numeric THEN ('Trafego SEM venda ('::text || p.ses) || ' sessoes, 0 pedidos): verificar estoque/preco/listagem'::text
            WHEN (100::numeric * p.bb) < 90::numeric AND p.v > 0::numeric THEN ('Buy box '::text || round(100::numeric * p.bb)) || '%: revisar preco/saude da conta (perdendo a caixa de compra)'::text
            WHEN (100.0 * p.ped / NULLIF(p.ses, 0::numeric)) < 10::numeric AND p.ses > 200::numeric THEN ((('Conversao '::text || round(100.0 * p.ped / NULLIF(p.ses, 0::numeric), 1)) || '% com '::text) || p.ses) || ' sessoes: revisar preco/fotos/titulo/reviews'::text
            WHEN (100.0 * COALESCE(a.adcost, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(p.v, 0::numeric)) > 25::numeric THEN ('Dependente de ads (TACoS '::text || round(100.0 * a.adcost / NULLIF(p.v, 0::numeric), 1)) || '%): fortalecer organico/listagem'::text
            WHEN p.ses > 500::numeric AND (100.0 * p.ped / NULLIF(p.ses, 0::numeric)) < 15::numeric THEN 'Trafego alto convertendo abaixo da media (~19%): otimizar listagem'::text
            ELSE 'Ok / manter'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM p
     LEFT JOIN ads a ON a.asin = p.asin
  WHERE p.v > 0::numeric OR p.ses > 0::numeric
  ORDER BY p.v DESC NULLS LAST, p.ses DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_aest_fora_fba as

            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) FILTER (WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Merchant'::text) AS fbm,
            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) AS total,
            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.quantity) FILTER (WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Merchant'::text) AS un_fbm
           FROM fact_amazon_pedido
          WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29) AND fact_amazon_pedido.order_status <> 'Cancelled'::text
          GROUP BY fact_amazon_pedido.asin
        ), rep AS (
         SELECT vw_amazon_reposicao.asin,
            bool_or(vw_amazon_reposicao.em_fba) AS em_fba
           FROM vw_amazon_reposicao
          GROUP BY vw_amazon_reposicao.asin
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(p.titulo, a.asin) AS produto,
    a.asin,
    round(a.fbm) AS vendas_fbm,
    a.un_fbm AS unidades_fbm,
    round(100.0 * a.fbm / NULLIF(a.total, 0::numeric), 1) AS pct_produto_fora_fba,
        CASE
            WHEN r.em_fba THEN 'Esta no FBA mas ainda vende FBM: repor estoque FBA / revisar preco FBM'::text
            ELSE 'NAO esta no FBA: enviar ao FBA (perdendo Buy Box/Prime)'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM a
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dim_amazon_produto.asin,
            max(dim_amazon_produto.titulo) AS titulo
           FROM dim_amazon_produto
          GROUP BY dim_amazon_produto.asin) p ON p.asin = a.asin
     LEFT JOIN rep r ON r.asin = a.asin
  WHERE a.fbm > 0::numeric
  ORDER BY a.fbm DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_aest_kpi as
 WITH f AS (
         SELECT sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) FILTER (WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Amazon'::text) AS fba,
            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) FILTER (WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Merchant'::text) AS fbm,
            sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price) AS total,
            count(DISTINCT
                CASE
                    WHEN fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Merchant'::text THEN fact_amazon_pedido.asin
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS asins_fbm
           FROM fact_amazon_pedido
          WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29) AND fact_amazon_pedido.order_status <> 'Cancelled'::text
        ), al AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE vw_amazon_reposicao.alerta = ANY (ARRAY['rupturado'::text, 'critico'::text])) AS ruptura,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vw_amazon_reposicao.alerta = 'fora_do_fba'::text) AS fora
           FROM vw_amazon_reposicao
        )
 SELECT metrica,
    valor,
    meta
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS ord,
            'Vendas FBA'::text AS metrica,
            ((('R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(( SELECT f.fba
                   FROM f)), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text)) || ' ('::text) || round(100.0 * (( SELECT f.fba
                   FROM f)) / NULLIF(( SELECT f.total
                   FROM f), 0::numeric))) || '%)'::text AS valor,
            NULL::text AS meta
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 2,
            'Vendas FBM (fora do FBA)'::text,
            ((('R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(( SELECT f.fbm
                   FROM f)), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text)) || ' ('::text) || round(100.0 * (( SELECT f.fbm
                   FROM f)) / NULLIF(( SELECT f.total
                   FROM f), 0::numeric))) || '%)'::text,
            NULL::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 3,
            '% vendas FORA do FBA'::text,
            replace(to_char(round(100.0 * (( SELECT f.fbm
                   FROM f)) / NULLIF(( SELECT f.total
                   FROM f), 0::numeric), 1), 'FM990.0'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) || '%'::text,
            '0% (ideal: tudo no FBA)'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 4,
            'ASINs vendendo FBM'::text,
            (( SELECT f.asins_fbm
                   FROM f))::text AS asins_fbm,
            '0'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 5,
            'Rupturas iminentes (FBA)'::text,
            (( SELECT al.ruptura
                   FROM al))::text AS ruptura,
            '0'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 6,
            'Itens fora do FBA (reposicao)'::text,
            (( SELECT al.fora
                   FROM al))::text AS fora,

           FROM fact_amazon_venda_hora
          GROUP BY fact_amazon_venda_hora.data
        ), p AS (
         SELECT fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_dia AS data,
            count(DISTINCT fact_amazon_pedido.amazon_order_id) AS pedidos
           FROM fact_amazon_pedido
          WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.order_status <> ALL (ARRAY['Cancelled'::text, 'Canceled'::text])
          GROUP BY fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_dia
        )
 SELECT t.data,
        CASE
            WHEN t.em_consolidacao AND h.data IS NOT NULL THEN round(h.venda, 2)
            ELSE t.vendas
        END AS vendas,
        CASE
            WHEN t.em_consolidacao AND h.data IS NOT NULL THEN h.unidades
            ELSE t.unidades
        END AS unidades,
        CASE
            WHEN t.em_consolidacao AND h.data IS NOT NULL THEN h.itens
            ELSE t.pedidos_itens
        END AS pedidos_itens,

    t.pageviews,
    t.taxa_conversao,
    t.buybox_pct,

            WHEN t.pedidos_itens > 0::numeric THEN round(t.vendas / t.pedidos_itens, 2)

create or replace view public.vw_amazon_tendencia_semana as

        ), g AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,

            count(*) AS dias
           FROM fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia
          WHERE fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia.data >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '70 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), ads AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,

           FROM vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia.data >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '70 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_amazon_ads_por_tipo_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        )
 SELECT to_char(g.semana::timestamp with time zone, 'DD/MM'::text) AS semana,
    g.semana AS semana_ini,
    g.semana = (( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk)) AS parcial,
    g.semana >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk)) - '14 days'::interval) AS ads_maturando,
    round(g.fat) AS faturamento,
    g.unid AS unidades,
    g.ped AS pedidos,

    round(COALESCE(a.gasto, 0::numeric)) AS invest_ads,

    round(100.0 * g.dev / NULLIF(g.unid, 0::numeric), 1) AS devolucao_pct
   FROM g
     LEFT JOIN ads a ON a.semana = g.semana
  WHERE g.dias >= 7 OR g.semana = (( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk))
  ORDER BY g.semana;

create or replace view public.vw_avg_produtos as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(vw_amazon_produto_dia.titulo, vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin) AS produto,
            vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin AS asin,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.vendas) AS v,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.unidades) AS un,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.sessoes) AS ses,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.pedidos_itens) AS ped,
            sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.buybox_pct * vw_amazon_produto_dia.pageviews) / NULLIF(sum(vw_amazon_produto_dia.pageviews), 0::numeric) AS bb
           FROM vw_amazon_produto_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_produto_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 31) AND NOT vw_amazon_produto_dia.em_consolidacao
          GROUP BY (COALESCE(vw_amazon_produto_dia.titulo, vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin)), vw_amazon_produto_dia.child_asin
        )
 SELECT "left"(produto, 40) AS produto,
    asin,
    round(v) AS faturamento,
    un AS unidades,
    ses AS sessoes,
    round(100.0 * ped / NULLIF(ses, 0::numeric), 1) AS conversao_pct,
    round(100::numeric * bb, 1) AS buybox_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (100.0 * ped / NULLIF(ses, 0::numeric)) < 10::numeric AND ses > 200::numeric THEN 'Conversao baixa com trafego: revisar preco/listagem/reviews'::text
            WHEN (100::numeric * bb) < 90::numeric THEN 'Buy box baixo: revisar preco/saude da conta'::text
            ELSE 'Manter'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM p
  WHERE v > 0::numeric
  ORDER BY v DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_avg_tendencia as
 WITH w AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_amazon_geral_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,

            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.sessoes) AS ses,
            sum(vw_amazon_geral_dia.pedidos_itens) AS ped
           FROM vw_amazon_geral_dia
          WHERE vw_amazon_geral_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 49) AND NOT vw_amazon_geral_dia.em_consolidacao
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_amazon_geral_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        )
 SELECT semana,
    round(v) AS faturamento,
    ses AS sessoes,
    round(100.0 * ped / NULLIF(ses, 0::numeric), 1) AS conversao_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN lag(v) OVER (ORDER BY semana) IS NULL THEN 'Semana base'::text
            WHEN v > lag(v) OVER (ORDER BY semana) THEN 'Vendas subindo vs semana anterior'::text
            ELSE 'Vendas caindo vs semana anterior'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM w

create or replace view public.vw_brand_momentum as
 WITH mx AS (
         SELECT max(vw_brand_ads_keyword.date) AS d
           FROM vw_brand_ads_keyword
        ), seg AS (
         SELECT vw_brand_termos.termo,
            max(vw_brand_termos.segmento) AS segmento
           FROM vw_brand_termos
          GROUP BY vw_brand_termos.termo
        ), base AS (
         SELECT k.termo,
            sum(k.cost) FILTER (WHERE k.date > (m.d - 7)) AS inv_a,
            sum(k.cost) FILTER (WHERE k.date <= (m.d - 7) AND k.date > (m.d - 14)) AS inv_b,
            sum(k.receita) FILTER (WHERE k.date > (m.d - 7)) AS rec_a,
            sum(k.receita) FILTER (WHERE k.date <= (m.d - 7) AND k.date > (m.d - 14)) AS rec_b,
            sum(k.prints) FILTER (WHERE k.date > (m.d - 7)) AS imp_a,
            sum(k.prints) FILTER (WHERE k.date <= (m.d - 7) AND k.date > (m.d - 14)) AS imp_b,
            sum(k.clicks) FILTER (WHERE k.date > (m.d - 7)) AS clk_a,
            sum(k.pedidos) FILTER (WHERE k.date > (m.d - 7)) AS ped_a
           FROM vw_brand_ads_keyword k
             CROSS JOIN mx m
          WHERE k.date > (m.d - 14)
          GROUP BY k.termo
        ), c AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(s.segmento, '?'::text) AS segmento,
            b.termo,
            round(b.inv_a, 0) AS invest_atual,
            round(b.inv_b, 0) AS invest_ant,
            round(100.0 * (b.inv_a - b.inv_b) / NULLIF(b.inv_b, 0::numeric), 0) AS invest_delta_pct,
            round(b.rec_a / NULLIF(b.inv_a, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_atual,
            round(b.rec_b / NULLIF(b.inv_b, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_ant,
            5.0 AS meta_roas,
            round(100.0 * b.clk_a::numeric / NULLIF(b.imp_a, 0::numeric), 2) AS ctr_atual,
            round(b.imp_a, 0) AS impressoes_atual,
            b.ped_a AS pedidos_atual
           FROM base b
             LEFT JOIN seg s ON s.termo = b.termo
          WHERE b.inv_a > 0::numeric OR b.inv_b > 0::numeric
        )
 SELECT segmento,
    termo,
    invest_atual,
    invest_ant,
    invest_delta_pct,
    roas_atual,
    roas_ant,
    meta_roas,
    ctr_atual,
    impressoes_atual,
    pedidos_atual,
        CASE
            WHEN roas_atual >= meta_roas AND invest_delta_pct <= '-10'::integer::numeric THEN 'vencedor_reduzido'::text
            WHEN invest_delta_pct >= 15::numeric AND roas_atual < roas_ant AND roas_atual < meta_roas THEN 'escalando_em_queda'::text
            WHEN impressoes_atual < 1000::numeric THEN 'amostra_baixa'::text
            WHEN roas_atual > roas_ant AND roas_atual < meta_roas THEN 'recuperando'::text
            WHEN roas_atual >= meta_roas THEN 'saudavel'::text
            ELSE 'abaixo_meta'::text
        END AS flag,
        CASE
            WHEN roas_atual >= meta_roas AND invest_delta_pct <= '-10'::integer::numeric THEN 'Vencedor (ROAS>=5) teve verba REDUZIDA - era pra escalar, nao cortar. Reverter e aumentar orcamento'::text
            WHEN invest_delta_pct >= 15::numeric AND roas_atual < roas_ant AND roas_atual < meta_roas THEN 'Escalou verba e ROAS caiu abaixo de 5 - segurar; provavelmente termo amplo, considerar negativar'::text
            WHEN impressoes_atual < 1000::numeric THEN 'Amostra baixa (<1k impressoes) - decidir so quando amadurecer'::text
            WHEN roas_atual > roas_ant AND roas_atual < meta_roas THEN 'Recuperando rumo a meta 5 - manter e observar'::text
            WHEN roas_atual >= meta_roas THEN 'Na meta (ROAS>=5) - candidato a escalar se tiver headroom'::text
            ELSE 'Abaixo da meta 5 - se for amplo, reduzir/negativar; se especifico, ajustar lance'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM c
  ORDER BY invest_atual DESC NULLS LAST;

create or replace view public.vw_brand_segmentos as
 WITH k AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN vw_brand_ads_keyword.termo ~* 'soldiers'::text THEN '1 Marca'::text
                    WHEN lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM vw_brand_ads_keyword.termo)) ~ '^(creatina|whey|prote[i├¡]na|suplementos?( alimentar)?|pr[e├®][ -]?treino|amino[a├í]cidos?|bcaa|termog[e├¬]nicos?)$'::text THEN '3 Generico amplo'::text
                    ELSE '2 Generico especifico'::text
                END AS seg,
            vw_brand_ads_keyword.cost,
            vw_brand_ads_keyword.receita,
            vw_brand_ads_keyword.clicks,
            vw_brand_ads_keyword.prints,
            vw_brand_ads_keyword.pedidos
           FROM vw_brand_ads_keyword
          WHERE vw_brand_ads_keyword.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
        )
 SELECT seg AS segmento,
    round(sum(cost)) AS invest,
    round(100::numeric * sum(cost) / sum(sum(cost)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct,
    round(sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    5 AS meta,
    round(100.0 * sum(clicks)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(prints), 0::numeric), 1) AS ctr,
    round(100.0 * sum(pedidos)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(clicks), 0)::numeric, 1) AS cvr,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) < 5::numeric THEN 'Abaixo da meta 5: '::text ||
            CASE
                WHEN seg = '3 Generico amplo'::text THEN 'negativar/reduzir amplos improdutivos'::text
                WHEN seg = '1 Marca'::text THEN 'defender e otimizar marca'::text
                ELSE 'empurrar especificos (lance/competitividade de leilao)'::text
            END
            ELSE 'Ok, escalar'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM k
  GROUP BY seg
  ORDER BY seg;

create or replace view public.vw_brand_termos as
 WITH k AS (
         SELECT vw_brand_ads_keyword.termo,
                CASE
                    WHEN vw_brand_ads_keyword.termo ~* 'soldiers'::text THEN 'Marca'::text
                    WHEN lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM vw_brand_ads_keyword.termo)) ~ '^(creatina|whey|prote[i├¡]na|suplementos?( alimentar)?|pr[e├®][ -]?treino|amino[a├í]cidos?|bcaa|termog[e├¬]nicos?)$'::text THEN 'Amplo'::text
                    ELSE 'Especifico'::text
                END AS seg,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_keyword.cost) AS inv,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_keyword.receita) AS rec,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_keyword.clicks) AS cl,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_keyword.prints) AS pr,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_keyword.pedidos) AS ped
           FROM vw_brand_ads_keyword
          WHERE vw_brand_ads_keyword.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
          GROUP BY vw_brand_ads_keyword.termo
        )
 SELECT "left"(termo, 30) AS termo,
    seg AS segmento,
    round(inv) AS invest,
    round(rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * cl::numeric / NULLIF(pr, 0::numeric), 1) AS ctr,
    round(100.0 * ped::numeric / NULLIF(cl, 0)::numeric, 1) AS cvr,
        CASE
            WHEN (rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric)) < 1::numeric THEN ('NEGATIVAR (ROAS '::text || round(rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric), 2)) || ', queima verba)'::text
            WHEN seg = 'Amplo'::text AND (rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric)) < 3::numeric THEN ('Reduzir/negativar (amplo ROAS '::text || round(rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric), 2)) || ')'::text
            WHEN (rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric)) >= 6::numeric THEN ('ESCALAR (ROAS '::text || round(rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric), 2)) || ' subfinanciado)'::text
            WHEN (rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric)) >= 4::numeric AND (rec / NULLIF(inv, 0::numeric)) <= 6::numeric THEN 'Empurrar p/ meta 5 (lance/competitividade)'::text
            ELSE 'Monitorar'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM k
  WHERE pr >= 1000::numeric
  ORDER BY inv DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_cad_produtos as
 WITH v AS (
         SELECT vw_ml_anuncio_dia.item_id,
            sum(vw_ml_anuncio_dia.unidades) AS unid,
            sum(vw_ml_anuncio_dia.faturamento) AS fat
           FROM vw_ml_anuncio_dia
          WHERE vw_ml_anuncio_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
          GROUP BY vw_ml_anuncio_dia.item_id
        )
 SELECT "left"(i.title, 40) AS anuncio,
    COALESCE(v.unid, 0::numeric) AS unidades,
    jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(i.raw -> 'pictures'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) AS fotos,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(i.raw -> 'attributes'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) a(value)
          WHERE (a.value ->> 'value_name'::text) IS NULL) AS atributos_vazios,
        CASE
            WHEN (i.raw ->> 'video_id'::text) IS NULL THEN 'NAO'::text
            ELSE 'sim'::text
        END AS tem_video,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.raw ->> 'warranty'::text, ''::text) = ''::text THEN 'NAO'::text
            ELSE 'sim'::text
        END AS tem_garantia,
    i.health,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' | '::text,
        CASE
            WHEN (i.raw ->> 'video_id'::text) IS NULL THEN 'add video'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(i.raw -> 'pictures'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) < 6 THEN ('subir p/ 6+ fotos (tem '::text || jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(i.raw -> 'pictures'::text, '[]'::jsonb))) || ')'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (( SELECT count(*) AS count
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(i.raw -> 'attributes'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) a(value)
              WHERE (a.value ->> 'value_name'::text) IS NULL)) > 0 THEN 'preencher ficha tecnica'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.raw ->> 'warranty'::text, ''::text) = ''::text THEN 'add garantia'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END), ''::text), 'Cadastro completo'::text) AS sugestao
   FROM ml_item i
     LEFT JOIN v ON v.item_id = i.item_id
  WHERE i.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY (COALESCE(v.fat, 0::numeric)) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_cad_resumo as
 SELECT item,
    qtd,
    sugestao
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS ord,
            'Sem video'::text AS item,

            'Adicionar video (aumenta conversao e ranking)'::text AS sugestao
           FROM ml_item

         SELECT 2,
            'Menos de 6 fotos'::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(ml_item.raw -> 'pictures'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) < 6) AS count,
            'Completar para 6-8 fotos (angulos, rotulo, modo de uso, tabela)'::text
           FROM ml_item
          WHERE ml_item.status = 'active'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 3,
            'Sem garantia'::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(ml_item.raw ->> 'warranty'::text, ''::text) = ''::text) AS count,
            'Padronizar garantia'::text
           FROM ml_item
          WHERE ml_item.status = 'active'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 4,
            'Ficha tecnica incompleta'::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(ml_item.raw -> 'attributes'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) a(value)
                  WHERE (a.value ->> 'value_name'::text) IS NULL)) > 0) AS count,
            'Preencher atributos vazios'::text
           FROM ml_item
          WHERE ml_item.status = 'active'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 5,
            'Health abaixo de 0,8'::text,

create or replace view public.vw_cliente_frequencia as
 SELECT faixa,
    ordem,
    count(*) AS clientes,
    round(100.0 * count(*)::numeric / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_clientes,
    sum(pedidos) AS pedidos,
    sum(faturamento) AS faturamento,
    round(100.0 * sum(faturamento) / sum(sum(faturamento)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_faturamento,

create or replace view public.vw_disp_criativos as
 WITH gm AS (
         SELECT vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.campaign_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN max(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal) = ANY (ARRAY['awareness'::text, 'guaranteed'::text]) THEN 'Topo'::text
                    WHEN max(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal) = 'consideration'::text THEN 'Meio'::text
                    WHEN max(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal) = 'conversion'::text THEN 'Fundo'::text
                    ELSE 'Outro'::text
                END AS grupo
           FROM vw_ml_display_campanha_dia
          GROUP BY vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.campaign_id
        ), c AS (
         SELECT gm.grupo,
            cr.creative_name,
            sum(cr.investimento) AS invest,
            sum(cr.receita) AS receita,
            sum(cr.impressoes) AS impr,
            sum(cr.cliques) AS cliques,
            count(DISTINCT cr.line_item_id) AS n_pub
           FROM vw_ml_display_criativo_dia cr
             JOIN gm ON gm.campaign_id = cr.campaign_id
          WHERE cr.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
          GROUP BY gm.grupo, cr.creative_name
        ), gavg AS (
         SELECT c_1.grupo,
            sum(c_1.cliques) / NULLIF(sum(c_1.impr), 0::numeric) AS ctr_grupo
           FROM c c_1
          GROUP BY c_1.grupo
        )
 SELECT grupo,
    "left"(creative_name, 38) AS criativo,
    round(invest) AS invest,
    round(receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * cliques::numeric / NULLIF(impr, 0::numeric), 3) AS ctr,
    round(invest / NULLIF(cliques, 0)::numeric, 2) AS cpc,
    impr AS impressoes,
    n_pub AS publicos,
        CASE
            WHEN impr < 1000::numeric THEN 'Em aprendizado (menos de 1.000 impressoes - nao decidir ainda)'::text
            WHEN grupo = 'Fundo'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric)) >= 6::numeric THEN (('ESCALAR (ROAS '::text || round(receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric), 2)) || ' > meta 6)'::text) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN n_pub <= 2 THEN ('; so roda em '::text || n_pub) || ' publico(s) -> TESTAR nos outros quentes'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END
                WHEN (receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric)) < 3::numeric THEN ('REVER (ROAS '::text || round(receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric), 2)) || '): checar se e o PUBLICO frio antes de culpar o criativo'::text
                ELSE ('Otimizar (ROAS '::text || round(receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric), 2)) || ' < 6): testar em publico mais quente'::text
            END
            ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN creative_name ~* '320|300x'::text AND (100.0 * cliques::numeric / NULLIF(impr, 0::numeric)) < 0.15 THEN ('Formato 320x50 mata o CTR ('::text || round(100.0 * cliques::numeric / NULLIF(impr, 0::numeric), 2)) || '%): trocar pelo tamanho normal'::text
                WHEN (cliques::numeric / NULLIF(impr, 0::numeric)) >= (( SELECT g.ctr_grupo
                   FROM gavg g
                  WHERE g.grupo = c.grupo)) THEN ('ESCALAR: CTR '::text || round(100.0 * cliques::numeric / NULLIF(impr, 0::numeric), 2)) || '% acima da media do grupo (baixa o CPC)'::text
                ELSE ('CTR '::text || round(100.0 * cliques::numeric / NULLIF(impr, 0::numeric), 2)) || '% abaixo da media: testar nova copy/arte (mesmo angulo de beneficio)'::text
            END
        END AS sugestao
   FROM c
  ORDER BY c.invest DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_disp_fadiga as
 WITH mx AS (
         SELECT max(vw_ml_display_line_item_dia.data) AS d
           FROM vw_ml_display_line_item_dia
        ), grp AS (
         SELECT vw_ml_display_campanha_lista.campaign_id,

                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_lista.goal = 'consideration'::text THEN 'Meio'::text
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_lista.goal = 'conversion'::text THEN 'Fundo'::text
                    ELSE 'Outro'::text
                END AS grupo
           FROM vw_ml_display_campanha_lista
        ), base AS (
         SELECT li.line_item_id,
            max(li.line_item_name) AS line_item,
            max(li.campaign_name) AS campanha,
            COALESCE(max(g.grupo), 'Outro'::text) AS grupo,
            sum(li.impressoes) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS imp_a,
            sum(li.impressoes) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS imp_b,
            sum(li.alcance) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS alc_a,
            sum(li.alcance) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS alc_b,
            sum(li.investimento) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS inv_a,
            sum(li.investimento) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS inv_b,
            sum(li.receita) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS rec_a,
            sum(li.receita) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS rec_b
           FROM vw_ml_display_line_item_dia li
             CROSS JOIN mx m
             LEFT JOIN grp g ON g.campaign_id = li.campaign_id
          WHERE li.data > (m.d - 14)
          GROUP BY li.line_item_id
        ), c AS (
         SELECT base.grupo,
            base.line_item,
            base.campanha,
            round(base.inv_a, 0) AS invest_atual,
            round(base.imp_a, 0) AS impressoes_atual,
            round(base.alc_a::numeric, 0) AS alcance_atual,
            round(base.imp_a / NULLIF(base.alc_a, 0)::numeric, 2) AS freq_atual,
            round(base.imp_b / NULLIF(base.alc_b, 0)::numeric, 2) AS freq_ant,
            round(base.rec_a / NULLIF(base.inv_a, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_atual,
            round(base.rec_b / NULLIF(base.inv_b, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_ant
           FROM base
          WHERE base.inv_a > 0::numeric
        )
 SELECT grupo,
    line_item,
    campanha,
    invest_atual,
    impressoes_atual,
    alcance_atual,
    freq_atual,
    freq_ant,
    roas_atual,
    roas_ant,
        CASE
            WHEN freq_atual >= 3.5 AND freq_atual > freq_ant AND roas_atual < roas_ant THEN 'saturado'::text
            WHEN roas_atual < roas_ant AND freq_atual <= COALESCE(freq_ant, freq_atual) THEN 'regressao_amostra'::text
            WHEN freq_atual < 2.0 AND alcance_atual >= 500000::numeric THEN 'headroom'::text
            ELSE 'saudavel'::text
        END AS classificacao,
        CASE
            WHEN freq_atual >= 3.5 AND freq_atual > freq_ant AND roas_atual < roas_ant THEN 'Saturacao real: freq subindo e ROAS caindo - reduzir verba e RENOVAR criativo'::text
            WHEN roas_atual < roas_ant AND freq_atual <= COALESCE(freq_ant, freq_atual) THEN 'Regressao de amostra (ROAS caiu SEM freq subir) - aceitar nivel real, NAO renovar'::text
            WHEN freq_atual < 2.0 AND alcance_atual >= 500000::numeric THEN 'Headroom: publico grande e freq baixa - pode escalar verba'::text
            ELSE 'Saudavel'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM c
  ORDER BY invest_atual DESC NULLS LAST;

create or replace view public.vw_disp_momentum as
 WITH mx AS (

                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_lista.goal = 'consideration'::text THEN 'Meio'::text
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_lista.goal = 'conversion'::text THEN 'Fundo'::text

                END AS grupo
           FROM vw_ml_display_campanha_lista
        ), base AS (
         SELECT li.line_item_id,
            max(li.line_item_name) AS line_item,
            max(li.campaign_name) AS campanha,
            COALESCE(max(g.grupo), 'Outro'::text) AS grupo,
            sum(li.investimento) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS inv_a,
            sum(li.investimento) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS inv_b,
            sum(li.receita) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS rec_a,
            sum(li.receita) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS rec_b,
            sum(li.impressoes) FILTER (WHERE li.data > (m.d - 7)) AS imp_a,
            sum(li.impressoes) FILTER (WHERE li.data <= (m.d - 7) AND li.data > (m.d - 14)) AS imp_b,

        ), c AS (

            c.cpc_ant,
            c.freq_atual,
            c.impressoes_atual,
            c.invb,
            c.ma,
            c.mb,
            round(100.0 * (c.ma - c.mb) / NULLIF(c.mb, 0::numeric), 0) AS metrica_delta_pct
           FROM c
        )
 SELECT grupo,
    line_item,
    campanha,
    invest_atual,
    invest_ant,
    invest_delta_pct,
    roas_atual,
    roas_ant,
    ctr_atual,
    ctr_ant,
    cpc_atual,
    cpc_ant,
    freq_atual,
    impressoes_atual,
        CASE
            WHEN grupo = 'Fundo'::text THEN 'ROAS'::text
            ELSE 'CTR'::text
        END AS metrica_decisao,
    metrica_delta_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN invb IS NULL OR invb = 0::numeric THEN
            CASE
                WHEN grupo = 'Fundo'::text AND roas_atual < 1::numeric THEN 'novo_frio'::text
                ELSE 'novo'::text
            END
            WHEN grupo = 'Fundo'::text AND roas_atual < (roas_ant * 0.7) AND impressoes_atual < 1000::numeric THEN 'regressao_amostra'::text
            WHEN invest_delta_pct > 15::numeric AND metrica_delta_pct < '-10'::integer::numeric THEN 'escalando_em_queda'::text
            WHEN freq_atual >= 3.5 AND metrica_delta_pct < 0::numeric THEN 'saturando'::text
            WHEN metrica_delta_pct > 10::numeric THEN 'recuperando'::text
            ELSE 'estavel'::text
        END AS flag,
        CASE
            WHEN invb IS NULL OR invb = 0::numeric THEN 'Verba nova nesta LINE - avaliar so apos >=1k impressoes; se Fundo e ROAS<1, cortar cedo'::text
            WHEN grupo = 'Fundo'::text AND roas_atual < (roas_ant * 0.7) AND impressoes_atual < 1000::numeric THEN 'Queda de ROAS em base pequena = regressao de amostra, nao saturacao; aceitar nivel real, nao renovar'::text
            WHEN invest_delta_pct > 15::numeric AND metrica_delta_pct < '-10'::integer::numeric THEN 'Escalando com metrica caindo - segurar verba ate estabilizar; so escalar LINE com metrica estavel >=7 dias'::text
            WHEN freq_atual >= 3.5 AND metrica_delta_pct < 0::numeric THEN 'Frequencia alta e metrica caindo = saturacao real; reduzir verba e renovar criativo'::text
            WHEN metrica_delta_pct > 10::numeric THEN 'Recuperando - manter e observar; candidata a escalar se sustentar'::text
            ELSE 'Estavel'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM d
  ORDER BY invest_atual DESC NULLS LAST;

create or replace view public.vw_disp_momentum_grupo as
 WITH mx AS (
         SELECT max(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data) AS d
           FROM vw_ml_display_campanha_dia
        ), b AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal = ANY (ARRAY['awareness'::text, 'guaranteed'::text]) THEN 'Topo'::text
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal = 'consideration'::text THEN 'Meio'::text
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal = 'conversion'::text THEN 'Fundo'::text
                    ELSE 'Outro'::text
                END AS grupo,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.investimento) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 7)) AS inv_a,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.investimento) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data <= (m.d - 7) AND vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 14)) AS inv_b,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.receita) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 7)) AS rec_a,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.receita) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data <= (m.d - 7) AND vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 14)) AS rec_b,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.impressoes) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 7)) AS imp_a,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.impressoes) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data <= (m.d - 7) AND vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 14)) AS imp_b,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.cliques) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 7)) AS clk_a,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.cliques) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data <= (m.d - 7) AND vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 14)) AS clk_b
           FROM vw_ml_display_campanha_dia
             CROSS JOIN mx m
          WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data > (m.d - 14)
          GROUP BY (
                CASE
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal = ANY (ARRAY['awareness'::text, 'guaranteed'::text]) THEN 'Topo'::text
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal = 'consideration'::text THEN 'Meio'::text
                    WHEN vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.goal = 'conversion'::text THEN 'Fundo'::text
                    ELSE 'Outro'::text
                END)
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT sum(b_1.inv_a) AS ta,
            sum(b_1.inv_b) AS tb
           FROM b b_1
        )
 SELECT b.grupo,
    round(b.inv_a, 0) AS invest_atual,
    round(b.inv_b, 0) AS invest_ant,
    round(100.0 * b.inv_a / NULLIF(t.ta, 0::numeric), 1) AS share_atual_pct,
    round(100.0 * b.inv_b / NULLIF(t.tb, 0::numeric), 1) AS share_ant_pct,
        CASE b.grupo
            WHEN 'Fundo'::text THEN 73.0
            WHEN 'Meio'::text THEN 18.0
            WHEN 'Topo'::text THEN 10.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS meta_share_pct,
    round(b.rec_a / NULLIF(b.inv_a, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_atual,
    round(b.rec_b / NULLIF(b.inv_b, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_ant,
        CASE b.grupo
            WHEN 'Fundo'::text THEN 6.0
            WHEN 'Meio'::text THEN 2.0
            WHEN 'Topo'::text THEN 1.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS meta_roas,
    round(100.0 * b.clk_a::numeric / NULLIF(b.imp_a, 0::numeric), 2) AS ctr_atual,
    round(100.0 * b.clk_b::numeric / NULLIF(b.imp_b, 0::numeric), 2) AS ctr_ant,
    round(b.rec_a, 0) AS receita_atual,
        CASE b.grupo
            WHEN 'Fundo'::text THEN 'Decide por ROAS (meta 6)'::text
            ELSE 'Decide por CTR/CPC'::text
        END AS metrica_decisao,
        CASE b.grupo
            WHEN 'Fundo'::text THEN 'Fundo: decisao por ROAS (meta 6). Comparar roas_atual vs anterior e share vs 73%; descontar view-through 14d'::text
            WHEN 'Meio'::text THEN 'Meio: decisao por CTR/CPC (subir CTR baixa CPC). Share meta 18%'::text
            WHEN 'Topo'::text THEN 'Topo: decisao por CTR/CPC. Share meta 10%; formato 320x50 mata CTR'::text
            ELSE 'Grupo sem objetivo mapeado'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM b
     CROSS JOIN tot t
  ORDER BY b.inv_a DESC NULLS LAST;

          GROUP BY vw_google_keyword_dia.keyword_text, vw_google_keyword_dia.match_type
        )
 SELECT keyword_text AS keyword,

create or replace view public.vw_influenciador_360 as
 WITH dim AS (
         SELECT d_1.creator_id,
            d_1.nome,
            d_1.cupom,
            d_1.tiktok_username,
            d_1.grupo_cupom,
            d_1.modelo_remuneracao,
            d_1.status,
            d_1.tier,
            d_1.categoria,
            d_1.subsegmento,
            d_1.cidade,
            d_1.estado,
            d_1.seguidores_ig,
            d_1.seguidores_tt,
            COALESCE(d_1.cache_fixo, 0::numeric) AS cache_fixo,
            COALESCE(d_1.comissao_pct, 0::numeric) AS comissao_pct,
            COALESCE(d_1.custo_total, 0::numeric) AS custo_planilha,
            d_1.data_inicio,
            d_1.data_fim
           FROM dim_influenciador d_1
        ), site AS (
         SELECT dim.creator_id,
            s.data,
            sum(s.faturamento_liquido) AS receita_site,
            sum(s.pedidos) AS pedidos_site,
            sum(s.unidades) AS unidades_site
           FROM dim
             JOIN vw_site_cupom_dia s ON s.cupom = dim.cupom
          GROUP BY dim.creator_id, s.data
        ), tiktok AS (
         SELECT dim.creator_id,
            f_1.data,
            round(sum(f_1.gmv), 2) AS receita_tiktok,
            sum(f_1.sku_orders) AS pedidos_tiktok,
            sum(f_1.unidades) AS unidades_tiktok,
            sum(f_1.views) AS views_tiktok
           FROM dim
             JOIN fact_tiktok_video_dia f_1 ON lower(f_1.criador) = lower(dim.tiktok_username)
          GROUP BY dim.creator_id, f_1.data
        ), datas AS (
         SELECT site.creator_id,
            site.data
           FROM site
        UNION
         SELECT tiktok.creator_id,
            tiktok.data
           FROM tiktok
        ), fato AS (
         SELECT dt.creator_id,
            dt.data,
            COALESCE(s.receita_site, 0::numeric) AS receita_site,
            COALESCE(s.pedidos_site, 0::numeric) AS pedidos_site,
            COALESCE(s.unidades_site, 0::numeric) AS unidades_site,
            COALESCE(tk.receita_tiktok, 0::numeric) AS receita_tiktok,
            COALESCE(tk.pedidos_tiktok, 0::bigint) AS pedidos_tiktok,
            COALESCE(tk.unidades_tiktok, 0::bigint) AS unidades_tiktok,
            COALESCE(tk.views_tiktok, 0::bigint) AS views_tiktok
           FROM datas dt
             LEFT JOIN site s ON s.creator_id = dt.creator_id AND s.data = dt.data
             LEFT JOIN tiktok tk ON tk.creator_id = dt.creator_id AND tk.data = dt.data
        ), primeira AS (
         SELECT fato.creator_id,
            min(fato.data) AS data_cache
           FROM fato
          GROUP BY fato.creator_id
        )
 SELECT d.creator_id,
    d.nome,
    d.cupom,
    d.tiktok_username,
    d.grupo_cupom,
    d.modelo_remuneracao,
    d.status,
    d.tier,
    d.categoria,
    d.subsegmento,
    d.cidade,
    d.estado,
    d.seguidores_ig,
    d.seguidores_tt,
    f.data,
    f.receita_site,
    f.pedidos_site,
    f.unidades_site,
    f.receita_tiktok,
    f.pedidos_tiktok,
    f.unidades_tiktok,
    f.views_tiktok,
    f.receita_site + f.receita_tiktok AS receita_total,
    f.pedidos_site + f.pedidos_tiktok::numeric AS pedidos_total,
        CASE
            WHEN p.data_cache = f.data THEN d.cache_fixo
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS cache_lancado,
    round(d.comissao_pct * (f.receita_site + f.receita_tiktok), 2) AS comissao_dia,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN p.data_cache = f.data THEN d.cache_fixo
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END + d.comissao_pct * (f.receita_site + f.receita_tiktok), 2) AS custo_dia,
    d.cache_fixo,
    d.comissao_pct,
    d.custo_planilha,
    d.data_inicio,
    d.data_fim
   FROM fato f
     JOIN dim d ON d.creator_id = f.creator_id
     JOIN primeira p ON p.creator_id = f.creator_id;

        )
 SELECT creator_id,

    status,
    tier,

        CASE
            WHEN custo_real > 0::numeric THEN round(receita_total / custo_real, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roi,
        CASE
            WHEN pedidos_total > 0::numeric THEN round(receita_total / pedidos_total, 2)

        END AS ticket,
        CASE

            WHEN receita_total = 0::numeric THEN 'Permuta sem venda rastreada no periodo. Conferir se o cupom esta ativo e divulgado.'::text

            ELSE 'Retorno saudavel. Manter e acompanhar.'::text

create or replace view public.vw_intraday_comparativo as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date AS hoje
        ), canais AS (
         SELECT c.canal,
            c.ordem
           FROM ( VALUES ('Mercado Livre'::text,1), ('Shopee'::text,2), ('Site'::text,3), ('TikTok'::text,4), ('Amazon'::text,5)) c(canal, ordem)
        ), bases AS (
         SELECT b.base,
            b.dias,
            b.ordem_base
           FROM ( VALUES ('Ontem'::text,1,1), ('D-7'::text,7,2), ('D-14'::text,14,3), ('D-28'::text,28,4)) b(base, dias, ordem_base)
        ), hoje AS (
         SELECT fact_venda_hora.canal,
            sum(fact_venda_hora.valor) AS vendido,
            max(fact_venda_hora.ultimo_ts) AS corte
           FROM fact_venda_hora
          WHERE fact_venda_hora.data = (( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p))
          GROUP BY fact_venda_hora.canal
        ), c AS (
         SELECT k.canal,
            k.ordem,
            COALESCE(h.vendido, 0::numeric) AS vendido,
            h.corte,
            EXTRACT(hour FROM (h.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text))::integer AS hh,
            (EXTRACT(minute FROM (h.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)) + EXTRACT(second FROM (h.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)) / 60.0) / 60.0 AS fr
           FROM canais k
             LEFT JOIN hoje h ON h.canal = k.canal
        ), linhas AS (
         SELECT c.canal,
            c.ordem,
            b.base,
            b.ordem_base,
            (( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p)) - b.dias AS data_ref,
            c.vendido,
            ( SELECT sum(
                        CASE
                            WHEN f.hora < c.hh THEN f.valor
                            WHEN f.hora = c.hh THEN f.valor * c.fr
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END) AS sum
                   FROM fact_venda_hora f
                  WHERE f.canal = c.canal AND f.data = ((( SELECT p.hoje
                           FROM p)) - b.dias)) AS ref_ate_mesmo_horario,
            ( SELECT sum(f.valor) AS sum
                   FROM fact_venda_hora f
                  WHERE f.canal = c.canal AND f.data = ((( SELECT p.hoje

        ), todas AS (

 SELECT canal,

create or replace view public.vw_intraday_hoje as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date AS hoje,
            (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text) AS agora
        ), canais AS (
         SELECT c.canal,
            c.ordem
           FROM ( VALUES ('Mercado Livre'::text,1), ('Shopee'::text,2), ('Site'::text,3), ('TikTok'::text,4), ('Amazon'::text,5)) c(canal, ordem)
        ), f AS (
         SELECT intraday_fatias.canal,
            intraday_fatias.hora,
            intraday_fatias.fatia,
            intraday_fatias.n_dias,
            intraday_fatias.curva_curta
           FROM intraday_fatias(( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p)) intraday_fatias(canal, hora, fatia, n_dias, curva_curta)
        ), v AS (
         SELECT fact_venda_hora.canal,
            sum(fact_venda_hora.valor) AS vendido,
            sum(fact_venda_hora.pedidos) AS pedidos,
            max(fact_venda_hora.ultimo_ts) AS corte,
            max(fact_venda_hora.atualizado_em) AS atualizado_em
           FROM fact_venda_hora
          WHERE fact_venda_hora.data = (( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p))
          GROUP BY fact_venda_hora.canal
        ), m AS (
         SELECT vw_meta_vs_real_dia.canal,
            sum(vw_meta_vs_real_dia.receita_meta) AS meta_dia
           FROM vw_meta_vs_real_dia
          WHERE vw_meta_vs_real_dia.data = (( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p))
          GROUP BY vw_meta_vs_real_dia.canal
        ), ev AS (
         SELECT string_agg(meta_evento.titulo, ' ┬À '::text) AS titulo,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or(meta_evento.tipo = ANY (ARRAY['pico'::text, 'feriado'::text])) THEN 'forte'::text
                    WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN 'leve'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS nivel
           FROM meta_evento
          WHERE meta_evento.data = (( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p))
        ), base AS (
         SELECT c.canal,
            c.ordem,
            COALESCE(v.vendido, 0::numeric) AS vendido,
            COALESCE(v.pedidos, 0::bigint) AS pedidos,
            v.corte,
            v.atualizado_em,
            m.meta_dia,
            EXTRACT(hour FROM (v.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text))::integer AS h,
            EXTRACT(minute FROM (v.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)) + EXTRACT(second FROM (v.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)) / 60.0 AS mi
           FROM canais c
             LEFT JOIN v ON v.canal = c.canal
             LEFT JOIN m ON m.canal = c.canal
        ), fr AS (
         SELECT b.canal,
            b.ordem,
            b.vendido,
            b.pedidos,
            b.corte,
            b.atualizado_em,
            b.meta_dia,
            b.h,
            b.mi,
            f0.fatia + (f1.fatia - f0.fatia) * (b.mi / 60.0) AS fatia,
            f0.n_dias,
            f0.curva_curta
           FROM base b
             LEFT JOIN f f0 ON f0.canal = b.canal AND f0.hora = b.h
             LEFT JOIN f f1 ON f1.canal = b.canal AND f1.hora = (b.h + 1)
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT fr.canal,
            fr.ordem,
            fr.vendido,
            fr.pedidos,
            fr.corte,
            fr.atualizado_em,
            fr.meta_dia,
            fr.h,
            fr.mi,
            fr.fatia,
            fr.n_dias,
            fr.curva_curta,
                CASE
                    WHEN fr.fatia >= 0.03 THEN fr.vendido / fr.fatia
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao,
            e.q10,
            e.q90
           FROM fr
             LEFT JOIN meta_intraday_erro e ON e.canal = fr.canal AND e.hora = GREATEST(8, LEAST(22, fr.h))
        ), canal_linhas AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p) AS data,
            calc.canal,
            calc.ordem,
            calc.corte,
            calc.vendido,
            calc.pedidos,
            calc.fatia,
            calc.projecao,
            calc.projecao * calc.q10 AS faixa_min,
            calc.projecao * calc.q90 AS faixa_max,
            calc.meta_dia,
            calc.n_dias,
            calc.curva_curta,
            calc.atualizado_em
           FROM calc
        ), total AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT p.hoje
                   FROM p) AS data,
            'Total'::text AS canal,
            9 AS ordem,
            min(canal_linhas.corte) AS corte,
            sum(canal_linhas.vendido) AS vendido,
            sum(canal_linhas.pedidos) AS pedidos,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(canal_linhas.projecao) = 5 THEN sum(canal_linhas.vendido) / NULLIF(sum(canal_linhas.projecao), 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS fatia,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(canal_linhas.projecao) = 5 THEN sum(canal_linhas.projecao)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao,
            sum(canal_linhas.meta_dia) AS meta_dia,
            min(canal_linhas.n_dias) AS n_dias,
            bool_or(canal_linhas.curva_curta) AS curva_curta,
            max(canal_linhas.atualizado_em) AS atualizado_em
           FROM canal_linhas
        ), total_faixa AS (
         SELECT t_1.data,
            t_1.canal,
            t_1.ordem,
            t_1.corte,
            t_1.vendido,
            t_1.pedidos,
            t_1.fatia,
            t_1.projecao,
            t_1.projecao * e.q10 AS faixa_min,
            t_1.projecao * e.q90 AS faixa_max,
            t_1.meta_dia,
            t_1.n_dias,
            t_1.curva_curta,
            t_1.atualizado_em
           FROM total t_1
             LEFT JOIN meta_intraday_erro e ON e.canal = 'Total'::text AND e.hora = GREATEST(8, LEAST(22, EXTRACT(hour FROM ( SELECT p.agora
                   FROM p))::integer))
        ), todas AS (
         SELECT canal_linhas.data,
            canal_linhas.canal,
            canal_linhas.ordem,
            canal_linhas.corte,
            canal_linhas.vendido,
            canal_linhas.pedidos,
            canal_linhas.fatia,
            canal_linhas.projecao,
            canal_linhas.faixa_min,
            canal_linhas.faixa_max,
            canal_linhas.meta_dia,
            canal_linhas.n_dias,
            canal_linhas.curva_curta,
            canal_linhas.atualizado_em
           FROM canal_linhas
        UNION ALL
         SELECT total_faixa.data,
            total_faixa.canal,
            total_faixa.ordem,
            total_faixa.corte,
            total_faixa.vendido,
            total_faixa.pedidos,
            total_faixa.fatia,
            total_faixa.projecao,
            total_faixa.faixa_min,
            total_faixa.faixa_max,
            total_faixa.meta_dia,
            total_faixa.n_dias,
            total_faixa.curva_curta,
            total_faixa.atualizado_em
           FROM total_faixa
        )
 SELECT data,
    canal,
    ordem,
    corte,
    to_char((corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text), 'HH24:MI'::text) AS corte_hhmm,
    round(vendido, 2) AS vendido,
    pedidos,
    round(fatia, 4) AS fatia_esperada,
    round(projecao, 2) AS projecao,
    round(faixa_min, 2) AS faixa_min,
    round(faixa_max, 2) AS faixa_max,
    round(meta_dia, 2) AS meta_dia,
    round(projecao / NULLIF(meta_dia, 0::numeric), 4) AS projecao_vs_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN projecao IS NULL OR meta_dia IS NULL THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (projecao / meta_dia) >= 1::numeric THEN 'No alvo'::text
            WHEN (projecao / meta_dia) >= 0.85 THEN 'Aten├º├úo'::text
            ELSE 'Abaixo'::text
        END AS farol,
    round(meta_dia * fatia, 2) AS meta_ate_agora,
    round(vendido / NULLIF(meta_dia * fatia, 0::numeric), 4) AS ritmo_vs_meta,
    n_dias AS n_dias_curva,
    COALESCE(curva_curta, false) AS curva_curta,
    ( SELECT ev.titulo
           FROM ev) AS evento_titulo,
    ( SELECT ev.nivel
           FROM ev) AS evento_nivel,
    EXTRACT(hour FROM ( SELECT p.agora
           FROM p)) >= 8::numeric AS mostrar_projecao,
    atualizado_em
   FROM todas t;

create or replace view public.vw_intraday_hoje_hora as
 WITH h AS (
