            vw_intraday_hoje.vendido,
            vw_intraday_hoje.pedidos,
            vw_intraday_hoje.fatia_esperada,
            vw_intraday_hoje.projecao,
            vw_intraday_hoje.faixa_min,
            vw_intraday_hoje.faixa_max,
            vw_intraday_hoje.meta_dia,
            vw_intraday_hoje.projecao_vs_meta,
            vw_intraday_hoje.farol,
            vw_intraday_hoje.meta_ate_agora,
            vw_intraday_hoje.ritmo_vs_meta,
            vw_intraday_hoje.n_dias_curva,
            vw_intraday_hoje.curva_curta,
            vw_intraday_hoje.evento_titulo,
            vw_intraday_hoje.evento_nivel,
            vw_intraday_hoje.mostrar_projecao,
            vw_intraday_hoje.atualizado_em
           FROM vw_intraday_hoje
          WHERE vw_intraday_hoje.canal <> 'Total'::text
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT vw_intraday_hoje.data,
            vw_intraday_hoje.canal,
            vw_intraday_hoje.ordem,
            vw_intraday_hoje.corte,
            vw_intraday_hoje.corte_hhmm,
            vw_intraday_hoje.vendido,
            vw_intraday_hoje.pedidos,
            vw_intraday_hoje.fatia_esperada,
            vw_intraday_hoje.projecao,
            vw_intraday_hoje.faixa_min,
            vw_intraday_hoje.faixa_max,
            vw_intraday_hoje.meta_dia,
            vw_intraday_hoje.projecao_vs_meta,
            vw_intraday_hoje.farol,
            vw_intraday_hoje.meta_ate_agora,
            vw_intraday_hoje.ritmo_vs_meta,
            vw_intraday_hoje.n_dias_curva,
            vw_intraday_hoje.curva_curta,
            vw_intraday_hoje.evento_titulo,
            vw_intraday_hoje.evento_nivel,
            vw_intraday_hoje.mostrar_projecao,
            vw_intraday_hoje.atualizado_em
           FROM vw_intraday_hoje
          WHERE vw_intraday_hoje.canal = 'Total'::text
        ), hc AS (
         SELECT min(EXTRACT(hour FROM (h.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)))::integer AS h_min
           FROM h
        ), f AS (
         SELECT intraday_fatias.canal,
            intraday_fatias.hora,
            intraday_fatias.fatia,
            intraday_fatias.n_dias,
            intraday_fatias.curva_curta
           FROM intraday_fatias(( SELECT max(h.data) AS max
                   FROM h)) intraday_fatias(canal, hora, fatia, n_dias, curva_curta)
        ), horas AS (
         SELECT generate_series(0, 23)::smallint AS hora
        ), vh AS (
         SELECT v.canal,
            v.hora,
            v.valor
           FROM fact_venda_hora v
          WHERE v.data = (( SELECT max(h.data) AS max
                   FROM h))
        ), serie AS (
         SELECT h.canal,
            hr.hora,
            h.data,
            EXTRACT(hour FROM (h.corte AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text))::integer AS h_corte,
            h.vendido,
            h.projecao,
            h.faixa_min,
            h.faixa_max,
            h.meta_dia,
            h.fatia_esperada,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(vh.valor), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM vh
                  WHERE vh.canal = h.canal AND vh.hora <= hr.hora) AS acum,
            f1.fatia AS fatia_fim
           FROM h
             CROSS JOIN horas hr
             LEFT JOIN f f1 ON f1.canal = h.canal AND f1.hora = (hr.hora + 1)
        ), linhas AS (
         SELECT serie.canal,
            serie.data,
            serie.hora,
            serie.hora + 1 AS hora_fim,
                CASE
                    WHEN serie.hora <= serie.h_corte THEN LEAST(serie.acum, serie.vendido)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS vendido_acum,
                CASE
                    WHEN serie.hora >= serie.h_corte AND serie.projecao IS NOT NULL AND serie.fatia_esperada < 1::numeric THEN serie.vendido + (serie.projecao - serie.vendido) * GREATEST(0::numeric, (serie.fatia_fim - serie.fatia_esperada) / (1::numeric - serie.fatia_esperada))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao_acum,
                CASE
                    WHEN serie.hora >= serie.h_corte AND serie.projecao IS NOT NULL AND serie.fatia_esperada < 1::numeric THEN serie.vendido + (serie.faixa_min - serie.vendido) * GREATEST(0::numeric, (serie.fatia_fim - serie.fatia_esperada) / (1::numeric - serie.fatia_esperada))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS faixa_min_acum,
                CASE
                    WHEN serie.hora >= serie.h_corte AND serie.projecao IS NOT NULL AND serie.fatia_esperada < 1::numeric THEN serie.vendido + (serie.faixa_max - serie.vendido) * GREATEST(0::numeric, (serie.fatia_fim - serie.fatia_esperada) / (1::numeric - serie.fatia_esperada))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS faixa_max_acum,
            serie.meta_dia * serie.fatia_fim AS meta_acum
           FROM serie
        ), total AS (
         SELECT 'Total'::text AS canal,
            l.data,
            l.hora,
            l.hora_fim,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(l.vendido_acum) = 5 THEN sum(l.vendido_acum)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS vendido_acum,
                CASE
                    WHEN (( SELECT tot.projecao
                       FROM tot)) IS NOT NULL AND l.hora >= (( SELECT hc.h_min
                       FROM hc)) THEN sum(COALESCE(l.projecao_acum, l.vendido_acum))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao_acum,
            sum(l.meta_acum) AS meta_acum
           FROM linhas l
          GROUP BY l.data, l.hora, l.hora_fim
        ), total_faixa AS (
         SELECT t.canal,
            t.data,
            t.hora,
            t.hora_fim,
            t.vendido_acum,
            t.projecao_acum,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.projecao_acum IS NOT NULL THEN tt.vendido + (tt.faixa_min - tt.vendido) * (t.projecao_acum - tt.vendido) / NULLIF(tt.projecao - tt.vendido, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS faixa_min_acum,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.projecao_acum IS NOT NULL THEN tt.vendido + (tt.faixa_max - tt.vendido) * (t.projecao_acum - tt.vendido) / NULLIF(tt.projecao - tt.vendido, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS faixa_max_acum,
            t.meta_acum
           FROM total t
             CROSS JOIN tot tt
        )
 SELECT linhas.canal,
    linhas.data,
    linhas.hora,
    linhas.hora_fim,
    round(linhas.vendido_acum, 2) AS vendido_acum,
    round(linhas.projecao_acum, 2) AS projecao_acum,
    round(linhas.faixa_min_acum, 2) AS faixa_min_acum,
    round(linhas.faixa_max_acum, 2) AS faixa_max_acum,
    round(linhas.meta_acum, 2) AS meta_acum
   FROM linhas
UNION ALL
 SELECT total_faixa.canal,
    total_faixa.data,
    total_faixa.hora,
    total_faixa.hora_fim,
    round(total_faixa.vendido_acum, 2) AS vendido_acum,
    round(total_faixa.projecao_acum, 2) AS projecao_acum,
    round(total_faixa.faixa_min_acum, 2) AS faixa_min_acum,
    round(total_faixa.faixa_max_acum, 2) AS faixa_max_acum,
    round(total_faixa.meta_acum, 2) AS meta_acum
   FROM total_faixa;

create or replace view public.vw_live_classificacao as
 WITH base AS (

        ), campanha AS (

            bool_or(COALESCE(base.titulo, ''::text) ~ '(^|[^0-9])([0-9]{1,2})\.\2([^0-9]|$)'::text) AS dia_de_campanha
           FROM base

        )
 SELECT b.id,
    b.canal,
    b.dia,

            WHEN 3 THEN 'quarta'::text
            WHEN 4 THEN 'quinta'::text
            WHEN 5 THEN 'sexta'::text

            ELSE 'domingo'::text
        END AS dia_semana,

        END AS faixa_audiencia,

create or replace view public.vw_live_dia as
 SELECT (inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date AS dia,
    canal,
    interna,
    count(*) AS lives,
    round(sum(COALESCE(gmv, 0::numeric)), 2) AS gmv,
    sum(COALESCE(pedidos, 0)) AS pedidos,
    sum(COALESCE(unidades, 0)) AS unidades,
    sum(COALESCE(clientes, 0)) AS clientes,
    sum(COALESCE(espectadores, 0)) AS espectadores,
    sum(COALESCE(visualizacoes, 0)) AS visualizacoes,
    sum(COALESCE(curtidas, 0)) AS curtidas,
    sum(COALESCE(comentarios, 0)) AS comentarios,
    sum(COALESCE(novos_seguidores, 0)) AS novos_seguidores,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN fim > inicio THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM fim - inicio) / 60.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 1) AS minutos_no_ar,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(COALESCE(pedidos, 0)) > 0 THEN round(sum(COALESCE(gmv, 0::numeric)) / sum(COALESCE(pedidos, 0))::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_medio,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(COALESCE(espectadores, 0)) > 0 THEN round(100.0 * sum(COALESCE(clientes, 0))::numeric / sum(COALESCE(espectadores, 0))::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS conversao_espectador_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(COALESCE(impressoes_produto, 0)) > 0 THEN round(100.0 * sum(COALESCE(cliques_produto, 0))::numeric / sum(COALESCE(impressoes_produto, 0))::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ctr_produto_pct
   FROM live_sessao

  GROUP BY ((inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date), canal, interna;

create or replace view public.vw_live_produto_dia as

create or replace view public.vw_live_sessao as

    s.fim,
        CASE
            WHEN s.fim > s.inicio THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.fim - s.inicio) / 60.0, 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS duracao_min,
    s.gmv,
    s.pedidos,
    s.unidades,
    s.clientes,
    s.produtos_distintos,
    s.espectadores,
    s.visualizacoes,
    s.tempo_medio_seg,
    s.curtidas,
    s.comentarios,
    s.compartilhamentos,
    s.novos_seguidores,
    s.impressoes_produto,
    s.cliques_produto,
        CASE
            WHEN s.pedidos > 0 THEN round(s.gmv / s.pedidos::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_medio,
        CASE
            WHEN s.fim > s.inicio AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.fim - s.inicio) > 0::numeric THEN round(s.gmv / (EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.fim - s.inicio) / 3600.0), 2)

            ELSE NULL::numeric

        CASE
            WHEN s.impressoes_produto > 0 THEN round(100.0 * s.cliques_produto::numeric / s.impressoes_produto::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ctr_produto_pct,

            WHEN s.cliques_produto > 0 THEN round(100.0 * s.pedidos::numeric / s.cliques_produto::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS clique_para_pedido_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN s.visualizacoes > 0 THEN round(1000.0 * s.gmv / s.visualizacoes::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gmv_por_mil_views,
    s.fonte,
    s.observacao,
    s.atualizado_em,

create or replace view public.vw_live_silencio as
 WITH ult AS (
         SELECT live_sessao.canal,
            max((live_sessao.inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date) AS ultimo_dia
           FROM live_sessao
          WHERE live_sessao.inicio IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE((live_sessao.bruto ->> 'is_test'::text)::boolean, false)
          GROUP BY live_sessao.canal
        )
 SELECT canal,
    ultimo_dia,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM generate_series((u.ultimo_dia + 1)::timestamp with time zone, ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 1)::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval) d(d)
          WHERE EXTRACT(isodow FROM d.d) < 6::numeric))::integer AS dias_uteis_sem_live,
        CASE canal
            WHEN 'shopee'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'tiktok'::text THEN 5
            ELSE 2
        END AS limite,
    ( SELECT round(sum(s2.gmv) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT (s2.inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date), 0)::numeric, 0) AS round
           FROM live_sessao s2
          WHERE s2.canal = u.canal AND s2.gmv IS NOT NULL AND s2.inicio >= (now() - '45 days'::interval)) AS gmv_por_dia_ativo
   FROM ult u;

create or replace view public.vw_live_ticket_dia as
 WITH live AS (
         SELECT (live_sessao.inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date AS dia,
            live_sessao.canal,
            sum(live_sessao.gmv) AS gmv,
            sum(live_sessao.pedidos) AS pedidos
           FROM live_sessao
          WHERE live_sessao.inicio IS NOT NULL AND (live_sessao.canal = ANY (ARRAY['shopee'::text, 'tiktok'::text])) AND NOT COALESCE((live_sessao.bruto ->> 'is_test'::text)::boolean, false)
          GROUP BY ((live_sessao.inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date), live_sessao.canal
        UNION ALL
         SELECT live_site_atribuicao_dia.dia,
            'site'::text AS text,
            sum(live_site_atribuicao_dia.valor) AS sum,
            sum(live_site_atribuicao_dia.pedidos) AS sum
           FROM live_site_atribuicao_dia
          GROUP BY live_site_atribuicao_dia.dia, 'site'::text
        ), canal AS (
         SELECT fact_receita_diaria.data AS dia,
                CASE fact_receita_diaria.canal_venda
                    WHEN 'Shopee'::text THEN 'shopee'::text
                    WHEN 'TikTok'::text THEN 'tiktok'::text
                    WHEN 'Site'::text THEN 'site'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS canal,
            sum(fact_receita_diaria.receita_total) AS receita,
            sum(fact_receita_diaria.pedidos) AS pedidos
           FROM fact_receita_diaria
          WHERE fact_receita_diaria.canal_venda = ANY (ARRAY['Shopee'::text, 'TikTok'::text, 'Site'::text])
          GROUP BY fact_receita_diaria.data, (
                CASE fact_receita_diaria.canal_venda
                    WHEN 'Shopee'::text THEN 'shopee'::text
                    WHEN 'TikTok'::text THEN 'tiktok'::text
                    WHEN 'Site'::text THEN 'site'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END)
        )
 SELECT c.dia,
    c.canal,
    round(l.gmv, 2) AS gmv_live,
    l.pedidos AS pedidos_live,
        CASE
            WHEN l.pedidos > 0 THEN round(l.gmv / l.pedidos::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_live,
    round(c.receita, 2) AS receita_canal,
    c.pedidos AS pedidos_canal,
        CASE
            WHEN c.pedidos > 0::numeric THEN round(c.receita / c.pedidos, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_canal,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.pedidos - COALESCE(l.pedidos, 0::bigint)::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round(c.receita - COALESCE(l.gmv, 0::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS receita_fora,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.pedidos - COALESCE(l.pedidos, 0::bigint)::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN c.pedidos - COALESCE(l.pedidos, 0::bigint)::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS pedidos_fora,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.pedidos - COALESCE(l.pedidos, 0::bigint)::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round((c.receita - COALESCE(l.gmv, 0::numeric)) / (c.pedidos - COALESCE(l.pedidos, 0::bigint)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_fora,
        CASE
            WHEN l.pedidos > 0 AND (c.pedidos - l.pedidos::numeric) > 0::numeric AND ((c.receita - l.gmv) / (c.pedidos - l.pedidos::numeric)) > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * (l.gmv / l.pedidos::numeric / ((c.receita - l.gmv) / (c.pedidos - l.pedidos::numeric)) - 1::numeric), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS premio_pct,
    c.canal = 'site'::text AS regua_e_piso
   FROM canal c
     LEFT JOIN live l ON l.canal = c.canal AND l.dia = c.dia
  WHERE c.canal IS NOT NULL;

create or replace view public.vw_live_top as

    (inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date AS dia,
    to_char((inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) AS data_br,
    to_char((inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text), 'HH24:MI'::text) AS hora_br,
    to_char((inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text), 'TMDy'::text) AS dia_semana,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM titulo), ''::text), 'sem titulo'::text) AS titulo,
        CASE
            WHEN fim > inicio THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM fim - inicio) / 60.0, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS duracao_min,
    round(gmv, 2) AS gmv,
    pedidos,
    unidades,
    espectadores,
        CASE
            WHEN pedidos > 0 THEN round(gmv / pedidos::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_medio,
        CASE
            WHEN fim > inicio THEN round(gmv / (EXTRACT(epoch FROM fim - inicio) / 3600.0), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gmv_por_hora,
        CASE
            WHEN espectadores > 0 AND pedidos IS NOT NULL THEN round(100.0 * pedidos::numeric / espectadores::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS pedidos_por_100_espectadores,
    canal = ANY (ARRAY['tiktok'::text, 'shopee'::text]) AS informa_receita
   FROM live_sessao s
  WHERE inicio IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE((bruto ->> 'is_test'::text)::boolean, false);

                    WHEN vw_meta_campanha_diario.objetivo = 'OUTCOME_LEADS'::text THEN 'Meio'::text
                    WHEN vw_meta_campanha_diario.objetivo = ANY (ARRAY['OUTCOME_TRAFFIC'::text, 'OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT'::text, 'OUTCOME_AWARENESS'::text, 'OUTCOME_REACH'::text, 'OUTCOME_VIDEO_VIEWS'::text]) THEN 'Topo'::text
                    ELSE 'Outros'::text
                END AS grupo,
            sum(vw_meta_campanha_diario.gasto) AS invest,
            sum(vw_meta_campanha_diario.receita) AS receita,
            sum(vw_meta_campanha_diario.cliques) AS cli,
            sum(vw_meta_campanha_diario.impressoes) AS imp
           FROM vw_meta_campanha_diario

        )
 SELECT campaign_name AS campanha,

    round(invest) AS invest,
    round(receita) AS receita,
    round(receita / NULLIF(invest, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * cli / NULLIF(imp, 0::numeric), 2) AS ctr_pct,
    round(invest / NULLIF(cli, 0::numeric), 2) AS cpc,
        CASE

            WHEN grupo = 'Topo'::text THEN 'Avaliar por CTR/CPC'::text

   FROM base

 SELECT c.nome AS criativo,

 SELECT ord,

create or replace view public.vw_meta_grupos as

         SELECT

                    WHEN vw_meta_campanha_diario.objetivo = 'OUTCOME_LEADS'::text THEN 2

                    WHEN vw_meta_campanha_diario.objetivo = 'OUTCOME_LEADS'::text THEN 'Meio (Consideracao)'::text
                    WHEN vw_meta_campanha_diario.objetivo = ANY (ARRAY['OUTCOME_TRAFFIC'::text, 'OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT'::text, 'OUTCOME_AWARENESS'::text, 'OUTCOME_REACH'::text, 'OUTCOME_VIDEO_VIEWS'::text]) THEN 'Topo (Alcance/Trafego)'::text
                    ELSE 'Outros/Sem objetivo'::text
                END AS grupo,

            vw_meta_campanha_diario.impressoes

        )
 SELECT ord,
    grupo,
    round(sum(gasto)) AS invest,
    round(100.0 * sum(gasto) / sum(sum(gasto)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct,
    round(sum(receita)) AS receita,
    round(sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(gasto), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * sum(cliques) / NULLIF(sum(impressoes), 0::numeric), 2) AS ctr_pct,
    round(sum(gasto) / NULLIF(sum(cliques), 0::numeric), 2) AS cpc,
        CASE
            WHEN ord = 3 THEN 'Meta ROAS 7 - decide por ROAS'::text

            WHEN ord = 2 THEN 'Meta ROAS 3'::text

        CASE
            WHEN ord = 3 AND (sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(gasto), 0::numeric)) < 7::numeric THEN 'Abaixo da meta 7: otimizar criativo/publico/pagina/preco'::text
            WHEN ord = 1 THEN 'Avaliar por CTR/CPC, nao por ROAS'::text
            ELSE 'Ok'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM base
  GROUP BY ord, grupo
  ORDER BY ord;

create or replace view public.vw_meta_resumo_mes as

    sum(receita_real_d1) AS receita_real,

    sum(ads_meta_acum_d1) AS ads_esperado,

    sum(invest_afil_meta) AS afil_meta,

    100.0 * sum(projecao_invest) / NULLIF(sum(projecao_receita), 0::numeric) AS pct_proj,
    sum(projecao_invest) - sum(COALESCE(invest_ads_meta, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(invest_afil_meta, 0::numeric)) AS excesso_fechamento,
    sum(receita_real_d1) / NULLIF(sum(ads_real_d1), 0::numeric) AS retorno_ads,

create or replace view public.vw_meta_vs_real_dia as
 WITH m AS (
         SELECT c.mes,
            c.data,
            c.canal,
            c.peso,
            mc.receita_total_meta * c.peso AS receita_meta,
            mc.invest_ads_meta * c.peso AS ads_meta,
            mc.receita_afil_meta * c.peso AS receita_afil_meta,
            mc.invest_afil_meta * c.peso AS invest_afil_meta,
            mc.receita_ads_meta * c.peso AS receita_ads_meta,
            mc.receita_ads_meta AS receita_ads_meta_mes,
            mc.invest_ads_meta AS invest_ads_meta_mes
           FROM meta_curva_dia c
             JOIN meta_canal_mes mc USING (mes, canal)
        )
 SELECT m.data,
    m.canal,
    m.mes,
    m.peso,
    m.receita_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN COALESCE(f.receita_total, rm.receita)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS receita_real,
    m.ads_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN COALESCE(f.invest_ads, rm.invest)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ads_real,
    m.receita_afil_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN af.rec
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS receita_afil_real,
    m.invest_afil_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN af.inv
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS invest_afil_real,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE AND m.receita_meta > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(f.receita_total, rm.receita) / m.receita_meta
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS atg_receita,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE AND m.ads_meta > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(f.invest_ads, rm.invest) / m.ads_meta
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS atg_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN COALESCE(f.invest_ads, rm.invest, 0::numeric) - m.ads_meta
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS excesso_ads_dia,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN COALESCE(f.receita_total, rm.receita, 0::numeric) - m.receita_meta
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS gap_receita_dia,
    m.data < CURRENT_DATE AS dia_fechado,
    m.data = CURRENT_DATE AS dia_em_curso,
    m.data > CURRENT_DATE AS dia_futuro,
    m.data >= (CURRENT_DATE - 2) AND m.data < CURRENT_DATE AS dado_provisorio,
    m.data >= (CURRENT_DATE - 15) AND m.data < CURRENT_DATE AS afiliado_maturando,
    to_char(m.data::timestamp with time zone, 'IYYY-IW'::text) AS semana,
    m.receita_ads_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE THEN f.receita_ads
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS receita_ads_real,
        CASE
            WHEN m.invest_ads_meta_mes > 0::numeric THEN m.receita_ads_meta_mes / m.invest_ads_meta_mes
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas_ads_meta,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(f.invest_ads, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN f.receita_ads / f.invest_ads
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas_ads_real,
        CASE
            WHEN m.data < CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(f.receita_total, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN f.receita_ads / f.receita_total
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS share_ads_real
   FROM m
     LEFT JOIN fact_receita_diaria f ON f.data = m.data AND f.canal_venda = m.canal
     LEFT JOIN mv_afiliado_canal_dia af ON af.data = m.data AND af.canal = m.canal
     LEFT JOIN realizado_manual rm ON rm.data = m.data AND rm.canal = m.canal;

create or replace view public.vw_meta_vs_real_mensal as
 WITH cur AS (
         SELECT meta_curva_dia.mes,
            meta_curva_dia.canal,
            sum(meta_curva_dia.peso) FILTER (WHERE meta_curva_dia.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS curva_d1,
            sum(meta_curva_dia.peso) FILTER (WHERE meta_curva_dia.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 3)) AS curva_d3
           FROM meta_curva_dia
          GROUP BY meta_curva_dia.mes, meta_curva_dia.canal
        ), rf AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, f.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes,
            f.canal_venda AS canal,
            sum(f.receita_total) FILTER (WHERE f.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS receita_d1,
            sum(f.invest_ads) FILTER (WHERE f.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS ads_d1,
            sum(f.receita_total) FILTER (WHERE f.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 3)) AS receita_d3
           FROM fact_receita_diaria f
          WHERE f.data >= '2026-08-01'::date
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, f.data::timestamp with time zone)::date), f.canal_venda
        ), ra AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, mv_afiliado_canal_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes,
            mv_afiliado_canal_dia.canal,
            sum(mv_afiliado_canal_dia.rec) FILTER (WHERE mv_afiliado_canal_dia.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS afil_rec_d1,
            sum(mv_afiliado_canal_dia.inv) FILTER (WHERE mv_afiliado_canal_dia.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS afil_inv_d1
           FROM mv_afiliado_canal_dia
          WHERE mv_afiliado_canal_dia.data >= '2026-08-01'::date
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, mv_afiliado_canal_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date), mv_afiliado_canal_dia.canal
        ), man AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, realizado_manual.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes,
            realizado_manual.canal,
            sum(realizado_manual.receita) FILTER (WHERE realizado_manual.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS rec_d1,
            sum(realizado_manual.invest) FILTER (WHERE realizado_manual.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS inv_d1
           FROM realizado_manual
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, realizado_manual.data::timestamp with time zone)::date), realizado_manual.canal
        ), b AS (
         SELECT mc.mes,
            mc.canal,
            mc.receita_total_meta,
            mc.receita_ads_meta,
            mc.invest_ads_meta,
            mc.receita_afil_meta,
            mc.invest_afil_meta,
            mc.share_afil_meta,
            mc.comissao_afil_meta,
            COALESCE(rf.receita_d1, man.rec_d1) AS receita_real_d1,
            COALESCE(rf.ads_d1, man.inv_d1) AS ads_real_d1,
            rf.receita_d3,
            ra.afil_rec_d1,
            ra.afil_inv_d1,
            cur.curva_d1,
            cur.curva_d3,
            ra.afil_inv_d1 IS NULL AND COALESCE(mc.invest_afil_meta, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AS afil_sem_lancamento
           FROM meta_canal_mes mc
             LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.mes = mc.mes AND cur.canal = mc.canal
             LEFT JOIN rf ON rf.mes = mc.mes AND rf.canal = mc.canal
             LEFT JOIN ra ON ra.mes = mc.mes AND ra.canal = mc.canal
             LEFT JOIN man ON man.mes = mc.mes AND man.canal = mc.canal
        ), d AS (
         SELECT b.mes,
            b.canal,
            b.receita_total_meta,
            b.receita_ads_meta,
            b.invest_ads_meta,
            b.receita_afil_meta,
            b.invest_afil_meta,
            b.share_afil_meta,
            b.comissao_afil_meta,
            b.receita_real_d1,
            b.ads_real_d1,
            b.receita_d3,
            b.afil_rec_d1,
            b.afil_inv_d1,
            b.curva_d1,
            b.curva_d3,
            b.afil_sem_lancamento,
            b.receita_total_meta * b.curva_d1 AS receita_meta_acum_d1,
            b.invest_ads_meta * b.curva_d1 AS ads_meta_acum_d1,
            b.invest_afil_meta * b.curva_d1 AS afil_meta_acum_d1,
            (COALESCE(b.invest_ads_meta, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(b.invest_afil_meta, 0::numeric)) * b.curva_d1 AS invest_meta_acum_d1,
            COALESCE(b.ads_real_d1, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(b.afil_inv_d1, 0::numeric) AS invest_real_d1,
            b.receita_real_d1 - b.receita_total_meta * b.curva_d1 AS gap_receita_d1
           FROM b
        ), e AS (
         SELECT d.mes,
            d.canal,
            d.receita_total_meta,
            d.receita_ads_meta,
            d.invest_ads_meta,
            d.receita_afil_meta,
            d.invest_afil_meta,
            d.share_afil_meta,
            d.comissao_afil_meta,
            d.receita_real_d1,
            d.ads_real_d1,
            d.receita_d3,
            d.afil_rec_d1,
            d.afil_inv_d1,
            d.curva_d1,
            d.curva_d3,
            d.afil_sem_lancamento,
            d.receita_meta_acum_d1,
            d.ads_meta_acum_d1,
            d.afil_meta_acum_d1,
            d.invest_meta_acum_d1,
            d.invest_real_d1,
            d.gap_receita_d1,
            d.ads_real_d1 - d.ads_meta_acum_d1 AS excesso_ads,
            d.afil_inv_d1 - d.afil_meta_acum_d1 AS excesso_afil,
            d.invest_real_d1 - d.invest_meta_acum_d1 AS excesso_invest,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.curva_d1 > 0::numeric THEN d.receita_real_d1 / d.curva_d1
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao_receita,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.curva_d1 > 0::numeric THEN d.ads_real_d1 / d.curva_d1
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao_ads,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.curva_d1 > 0::numeric THEN d.afil_inv_d1 / d.curva_d1
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao_afil,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.curva_d1 > 0::numeric THEN d.invest_real_d1 / d.curva_d1
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS projecao_invest,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.receita_real_d1 > 0::numeric THEN 100.0 * d.invest_real_d1 / d.receita_real_d1
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS pct_real,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.receita_total_meta > 0::numeric THEN 100.0 * (COALESCE(d.invest_ads_meta, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(d.invest_afil_meta, 0::numeric)) / d.receita_total_meta
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS pct_meta,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.receita_real_d1 > 0::numeric AND d.receita_total_meta > 0::numeric THEN 100.0 * d.invest_real_d1 / d.receita_real_d1 - 100.0 * (COALESCE(d.invest_ads_meta, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(d.invest_afil_meta, 0::numeric)) / d.receita_total_meta
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS desvio_pp,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.ads_real_d1 > 0::numeric THEN d.receita_real_d1 / d.ads_real_d1
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS retorno_ads
           FROM d
        )
 SELECT mes,
    canal,
    receita_total_meta,
    receita_ads_meta,
    invest_ads_meta,
    receita_afil_meta,
    invest_afil_meta,
    share_afil_meta,
    comissao_afil_meta,
    receita_real_d1,
    ads_real_d1,
    receita_d3,
    afil_rec_d1,
    afil_inv_d1,
    curva_d1,
    curva_d3,
    afil_sem_lancamento,
    receita_meta_acum_d1,
    ads_meta_acum_d1,
    afil_meta_acum_d1,
    invest_meta_acum_d1,
    invest_real_d1,
    gap_receita_d1,
    excesso_ads,
    excesso_afil,
    excesso_invest,
    projecao_receita,
    projecao_ads,
    projecao_afil,
    projecao_invest,
    pct_real,
    pct_meta,
    desvio_pp,
    retorno_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN receita_total_meta IS NULL OR receita_real_d1 IS NULL OR desvio_pp IS NULL THEN 'ÔÇô'::text
            WHEN desvio_pp <= 0::numeric THEN 'No alvo'::text
            WHEN excesso_invest > (0.02 * invest_meta_acum_d1) AND gap_receita_d1 < ('-0.02'::numeric * receita_meta_acum_d1) THEN 'Gasto e receita'::text
            WHEN excesso_invest > (0.02 * invest_meta_acum_d1) THEN 'Gasto acima'::text
            WHEN gap_receita_d1 < ('-0.02'::numeric * receita_meta_acum_d1) THEN 'Receita abaixo'::text
            ELSE 'Aten├º├úo'::text
        END AS origem_desvio,
        CASE
            WHEN curva_d3 IS NULL OR COALESCE(receita_total_meta, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric OR receita_d3 IS NULL THEN 'ÔÇô'::text
            WHEN (receita_d3 / NULLIF(receita_total_meta * curva_d3, 0::numeric)) >= 1::numeric THEN 'No alvo'::text
            WHEN (receita_d3 / NULLIF(receita_total_meta * curva_d3, 0::numeric)) >= 0.85 THEN 'Aten├º├úo'::text
            ELSE 'Abaixo'::text
        END AS farol_receita
   FROM e;

create or replace view public.vw_meta_vs_real_mes as
 WITH par AS (
         SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone)::date, '2026-09-01'::date) AS m
        ), cur AS (
         SELECT c.canal,
            sum(c.peso) FILTER (WHERE c.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS curva_d1,
            sum(c.peso) FILTER (WHERE c.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 3)) AS curva_d3
           FROM meta_curva_dia c,
            par par_1
          WHERE c.mes = par_1.m
          GROUP BY c.canal
        ), rf AS (
         SELECT f.canal_venda AS canal,
            sum(f.receita_total) FILTER (WHERE f.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS receita_d1,
            sum(f.invest_ads) FILTER (WHERE f.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS ads_d1,
            sum(f.receita_total) FILTER (WHERE f.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 3)) AS receita_d3,
            sum(f.invest_ads) FILTER (WHERE f.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 3)) AS ads_d3
           FROM fact_receita_diaria f,
            par par_1
          WHERE f.data >= par_1.m AND f.data < (par_1.m + '1 mon'::interval)
          GROUP BY f.canal_venda
        ), ra AS (
         SELECT x.canal,
            sum(x.rec) FILTER (WHERE x.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS afil_rec_d1,
            sum(x.inv) FILTER (WHERE x.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS afil_inv_d1
           FROM ( SELECT vw_ml_afiliado_dia.data,
                    'Mercado Livre'::text AS canal,
                    vw_ml_afiliado_dia.gmv_afiliado AS rec,
                    vw_ml_afiliado_dia.custo_afiliado AS inv
                   FROM vw_ml_afiliado_dia
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT vw_shopee_afiliado_dia.data,
                    'Shopee'::text,
                    vw_shopee_afiliado_dia.gmv_afiliado,
                    vw_shopee_afiliado_dia.custo_afiliado
                   FROM vw_shopee_afiliado_dia
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT vw_tiktok_afiliado_dia.data,
                    'TikTok'::text,
                    vw_tiktok_afiliado_dia.gmv_afiliado,
                    vw_tiktok_afiliado_dia.custo_total
                   FROM vw_tiktok_afiliado_dia) x,
            par par_1
          WHERE x.data >= par_1.m AND x.data < (par_1.m + '1 mon'::interval)
          GROUP BY x.canal
        ), man AS (
         SELECT rm.canal,
            sum(rm.receita) FILTER (WHERE rm.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS rec_d1,
            sum(rm.invest) FILTER (WHERE rm.data < CURRENT_DATE) AS inv_d1
           FROM realizado_manual rm,
            par par_1
          WHERE rm.data >= par_1.m AND rm.data < (par_1.m + '1 mon'::interval)
          GROUP BY rm.canal
        )
 SELECT mc.canal,
    mc.receita_total_meta,
    mc.receita_ads_meta,
    mc.invest_ads_meta,
    mc.receita_afil_meta,
    mc.invest_afil_meta,
    COALESCE(rf.receita_d1, man.rec_d1) AS receita_real_d1,
    COALESCE(rf.ads_d1, man.inv_d1) AS ads_real_d1,
    ra.afil_rec_d1,
    ra.afil_inv_d1,
    cur.curva_d1,
    cur.curva_d3,
    mc.receita_total_meta * cur.curva_d1 AS receita_meta_acum_d1,
    mc.invest_ads_meta * cur.curva_d1 AS ads_meta_acum_d1,
        CASE
            WHEN cur.curva_d3 > 0::numeric AND COALESCE(mc.receita_total_meta, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN rf.receita_d3 / (mc.receita_total_meta * cur.curva_d3)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS atg_receita_d3,
        CASE
            WHEN cur.curva_d1 > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(rf.receita_d1, man.rec_d1) / cur.curva_d1
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS projecao_receita,
        CASE
            WHEN cur.curva_d1 > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(rf.ads_d1, man.inv_d1) / cur.curva_d1
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS projecao_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN cur.curva_d3 IS NULL OR COALESCE(mc.receita_total_meta, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric OR rf.receita_d3 IS NULL THEN 'ÔÇô'::text
            WHEN (rf.receita_d3 / NULLIF(mc.receita_total_meta * cur.curva_d3, 0::numeric)) >= 1::numeric THEN 'No alvo'::text
            WHEN (rf.receita_d3 / NULLIF(mc.receita_total_meta * cur.curva_d3, 0::numeric)) >= 0.85 THEN 'Aten├º├úo'::text
            ELSE 'Abaixo'::text
        END AS farol_receita
   FROM meta_canal_mes mc
     JOIN par ON mc.mes = par.m
     LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.canal = mc.canal
     LEFT JOIN rf ON rf.canal = mc.canal
     LEFT JOIN ra ON ra.canal = mc.canal
     LEFT JOIN man ON man.canal = mc.canal;

create or replace view public.vw_ml_ads_saude as
 WITH dias AS (
         SELECT generate_series((CURRENT_DATE - 45)::timestamp with time zone, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS d
        ), fontes AS (
         SELECT 'product_ads'::text AS fonte,
            ml_product_ads_campanha_metricas.date AS d,
            sum(ml_product_ads_campanha_metricas.cost) AS v
           FROM ml_product_ads_campanha_metricas
          GROUP BY ml_product_ads_campanha_metricas.date
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'display'::text,
            ml_display_criativo_metricas.date,
            sum(ml_display_criativo_metricas.consumed_budget) AS sum
           FROM ml_display_criativo_metricas
          GROUP BY ml_display_criativo_metricas.date
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'brand_ads'::text,
            ml_brand_ads_metricas_dia.date,
            sum(ml_brand_ads_metricas_dia.consumed_budget) AS sum
           FROM ml_brand_ads_metricas_dia
          GROUP BY ml_brand_ads_metricas_dia.date
        ), grade AS (
         SELECT f.fonte,
            dias.d,
            COALESCE(x.v, 0::numeric) AS valor,
            x.d IS NULL AS sem_linha
           FROM dias
             CROSS JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT fontes.fonte
                   FROM fontes) f
             LEFT JOIN fontes x ON x.fonte = f.fonte AND x.d = dias.d
        ), viz AS (
         SELECT g.fonte,
            g.d,
            g.valor,
            g.sem_linha,
            lag(g.valor) OVER (PARTITION BY g.fonte ORDER BY g.d) AS ant,
            lead(g.valor) OVER (PARTITION BY g.fonte ORDER BY g.d) AS prox
           FROM grade g
        )
 SELECT fonte,
    d AS data,
    round(valor, 2) AS valor,
    round(ant, 2) AS dia_anterior,
    round(prox, 2) AS dia_seguinte,
        CASE
            WHEN sem_linha THEN 'SEM LINHA'::text
            WHEN valor = 0::numeric AND COALESCE(ant, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND COALESCE(prox, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN 'BURACO'::text
            ELSE 'ZERO'::text
        END AS situacao
   FROM viz
  WHERE d < CURRENT_DATE AND (sem_linha OR valor = 0::numeric AND COALESCE(ant, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND COALESCE(prox, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric)
  ORDER BY d DESC, fonte;

create or replace view public.vw_ml_afiliado_creator_resumo as
 WITH b AS (

            vw_ml_afiliado_base.valor_venda,

            vw_ml_afiliado_base.fee_pct,

           FROM vw_ml_afiliado_base
          WHERE vw_ml_afiliado_base.data >= (CURRENT_DATE - 30)
        ), r AS (
         SELECT b.afiliado_username,
            max(b.afiliado_nome) AS afiliado_nome,
            count(DISTINCT b.pedido_id) AS pedidos,
            sum(b.quantidade) AS unidades,

            count(DISTINCT b.item_id) AS skus,
            min(b.data) AS primeira_venda,
            max(b.data) AS ultima_venda,
            count(DISTINCT b.data) AS dias_ativos,
            mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.campanha_tipo) AS campanha_predominante
           FROM b

        ), c AS (
         SELECT r.afiliado_username,
            r.afiliado_nome,
            r.pedidos,
            r.unidades,
            r.gmv,
            r.custo,
            r.skus,
            r.primeira_venda,
            r.ultima_venda,
            r.dias_ativos,
            r.campanha_predominante,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY r.custo DESC) AS rank_custo,
            round(100.0 * sum(r.custo) OVER (ORDER BY r.custo DESC, r.afiliado_username) / NULLIF(sum(r.custo) OVER (), 0::numeric), 2) AS custo_acum_pct,
            round(100.0 * r.custo / NULLIF(sum(r.custo) OVER (), 0::numeric), 3) AS share_custo_pct,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.gmv DESC, r.afiliado_username) AS rank_gmv,
            round(100.0 * sum(r.gmv) OVER (ORDER BY r.gmv DESC, r.afiliado_username) / NULLIF(sum(r.gmv) OVER (), 0::numeric), 2) AS gmv_acum_pct,
            round(100.0 * r.gmv / NULLIF(sum(r.gmv) OVER (), 0::numeric), 3) AS share_gmv_pct,

            round(sum(r.custo) OVER (), 2) AS custo_total_geral,
            sum(r.pedidos) OVER () AS pedidos_total_geral,
            sum(r.unidades) OVER () AS unidades_total_geral
           FROM r
        )
 SELECT afiliado_username,

    pedidos,
    unidades,
    round(gmv, 2) AS gmv,
    round(custo, 2) AS custo,

    round(gmv / NULLIF(pedidos, 0)::numeric, 2) AS ticket,
    skus,
    dias_ativos,
    primeira_venda,
    ultima_venda,
    campanha_predominante,
    rank_custo,
    custo_acum_pct,
    share_custo_pct,
    rank_gmv,
    gmv_acum_pct,
    share_gmv_pct,
    total_afiliados,
    gmv_total_geral,
    custo_total_geral,
    pedidos_total_geral,
    unidades_total_geral,
    ( SELECT min(c_1.rank_gmv) AS min
           FROM c c_1
          WHERE c_1.gmv_acum_pct >= 50::numeric) AS afiliados_p50_venda,
    ( SELECT min(c_1.rank_gmv) AS min
           FROM c c_1
          WHERE c_1.gmv_acum_pct >= 80::numeric) AS afiliados_p80_venda
   FROM c;

create or replace view public.vw_ml_afiliado_dia as

            sum(vw_ml_afiliado_base.comissao_pedido) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_afiliado_base.campanha_tipo = 'CLOSED'::text) AS custo_exclusiva,
            sum(vw_ml_afiliado_base.valor_venda) FILTER (WHERE vw_ml_afiliado_base.campanha_tipo = 'OPEN'::text) AS gmv_aberta,

 SELECT a.data,
    m.ml_faltando = 0 AS completo,
    m.ml_faltando AS dias_ml_faltando,
    t.pedidos_total,
    a.pedidos_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * a.pedidos_afiliado::numeric / NULLIF(t.pedidos_total, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_pedidos_afiliado,
    a.unidades_afiliado,
    a.afiliados_ativos,
    round(t.gmv_total, 2) AS gmv_total,
    round(a.gmv_afiliado, 2) AS gmv_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * a.gmv_afiliado / NULLIF(t.gmv_total, 0::numeric), 2) AS pct_gmv_afiliado,
    round(a.custo_afiliado, 2) AS custo_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * a.custo_afiliado / NULLIF(a.gmv_afiliado, 0::numeric), 2) AS comissao_efetiva_pct,
    round(100.0 * a.custo_afiliado / NULLIF(t.gmv_total, 0::numeric), 2) AS custo_pct_gmv_total,
    round(a.ticket_afiliado, 2) AS ticket_afiliado,

    round(a.custo_exclusiva, 2) AS custo_exclusiva,

    round(a.gmv_aberta, 2) AS gmv_aberta,
    round(a.custo_aberta, 2) AS custo_aberta,

   FROM agg a
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS pedidos_total,
            sum(p.total_amount) AS gmv_total
           FROM ml_pedido p
          WHERE p.status = 'paid'::text AND p.data_venda = a.data) t ON true
     LEFT JOIN mat m ON m.data = a.data;

create or replace view public.vw_ml_concorrente_dia as
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT ml_concorrente_snapshot.data_ref,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.alias,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.categoria,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.receita_acum,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.unidades_acum,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.visitas_acum,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_anterior_acum,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_estimada,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_fonte,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.eh_piso,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.posicao
           FROM ml_concorrente_snapshot
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ml_concorrente_snapshot.data_ref,
            ml_concorrente_snapshot.alias,
            'total'::text,
            sum(ml_concorrente_snapshot.receita_acum) AS sum,
            sum(ml_concorrente_snapshot.unidades_acum) AS sum,
            sum(ml_concorrente_snapshot.visitas_acum) AS sum,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_anterior_acum IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE sum(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_anterior_acum)
                END AS sum,
            bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_estimada) AS bool_or,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_fonte = 'congelado'::text) THEN 'congelado'::text
                    WHEN bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_fonte = 'prorrateado'::text) THEN 'prorrateado'::text
                    WHEN bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_fonte = 'historico'::text) THEN 'historico'::text
                    WHEN bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.base_fonte = 'detalhe'::text) THEN 'detalhe'::text
                    ELSE 'ranking'::text
                END AS "case",
            bool_or(ml_concorrente_snapshot.eh_piso) AS bool_or,
            NULL::integer AS int4
           FROM ml_concorrente_snapshot
          GROUP BY ml_concorrente_snapshot.data_ref, ml_concorrente_snapshot.alias
        ), janela AS (
         SELECT b.data_ref,
            b.alias,
            b.categoria,
            b.receita_acum,
            b.unidades_acum,
            b.visitas_acum,
            b.base_anterior_acum,
            b.base_estimada,
            b.base_fonte,
            b.eh_piso,
            b.posicao,
            lag(b.data_ref) OVER w AS data_ant,
            lag(b.receita_acum) OVER w AS receita_ant,
            lag(b.unidades_acum) OVER w AS unidades_ant
           FROM base b
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY b.alias, b.categoria, (date_trunc('month'::text, b.data_ref::timestamp with time zone)) ORDER BY b.data_ref)
        )
 SELECT j.data_ref,
    date_trunc('month'::text, j.data_ref::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes,
    j.alias,
    d.nome,
    d.tipo,
    d.acompanhado,
    j.categoria,
    j.receita_acum,
    j.unidades_acum,
    j.visitas_acum,
    COALESCE(j.receita_acum - j.receita_ant, j.receita_acum) AS receita_periodo,
    COALESCE(j.unidades_acum - j.unidades_ant, j.unidades_acum) AS unidades_periodo,
    COALESCE(j.data_ref - j.data_ant, EXTRACT(day FROM j.data_ref)::integer) AS dias_cobertos,
    j.data_ant IS NULL AS primeira_do_mes,
    j.data_ant IS NOT NULL AND (j.data_ref - j.data_ant) > 1 AS periodo_agregado,
    round(COALESCE(j.receita_acum - j.receita_ant, j.receita_acum) / NULLIF(COALESCE(j.data_ref - j.data_ant, EXTRACT(day FROM j.data_ref)::integer), 0)::numeric, 2) AS receita_dia_media,
    j.base_anterior_acum,
        CASE
            WHEN j.base_anterior_acum > 0::numeric THEN round(j.receita_acum / j.base_anterior_acum - 1::numeric, 6)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS crescimento,
    j.base_estimada,
    j.base_fonte,
    j.eh_piso,
    j.posicao,
    j.data_ref = (date_trunc('month'::text, j.data_ref::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS mes_fechado
   FROM janela j
     JOIN dim_ml_concorrente d ON d.alias = j.alias;

create or replace view public.vw_ml_frete_dia as
 WITH it AS (
         SELECT i.pedido_id,
            i.data_venda,
            i.logistic_type,
            i.item_id,
            i.quantity,
            i.unit_price,
            i.sale_fee,
            p.status
           FROM ml_pedido_item_rt i
             LEFT JOIN ml_pedido_rt p ON p.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
        UNION ALL
         SELECT h.pedido_id,
            h.data_venda,
            h.logistic_type,
            h.item_id,
            h.quantity,
            h.unit_price,
            h.sale_fee,
            p.status
           FROM ml_pedido_item h
             LEFT JOIN ml_pedido p ON p.pedido_id = h.pedido_id
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM ml_pedido_item_rt r
                  WHERE r.pedido_id = h.pedido_id))
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT it.data_venda AS data,
            it.logistic_type,
            count(DISTINCT it.pedido_id) FILTER (WHERE it.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text) AS pedidos,
            sum(it.quantity) FILTER (WHERE it.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text) AS unidades,
            sum(it.unit_price * it.quantity::numeric) FILTER (WHERE it.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text) AS faturamento,
            count(DISTINCT it.item_id) FILTER (WHERE it.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text) AS produtos,
            sum(COALESCE(it.sale_fee, 0::numeric) * it.quantity::numeric) FILTER (WHERE it.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text) AS comissao,
            count(DISTINCT it.pedido_id) FILTER (WHERE it.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text AND COALESCE(it.sale_fee, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric) AS pedidos_com_comissao,
            count(DISTINCT it.pedido_id) FILTER (WHERE it.status = 'cancelled'::text) AS pedidos_cancelados,
            sum(it.unit_price * it.quantity::numeric) FILTER (WHERE it.status = 'cancelled'::text) AS faturamento_cancelado
           FROM it
          GROUP BY it.data_venda, it.logistic_type
        )
 SELECT data,
        CASE logistic_type
            WHEN 'fulfillment'::text THEN 'Full'::text
            WHEN 'self_service'::text THEN 'Flex'::text
            WHEN 'cross_docking'::text THEN 'Coleta (cross-docking)'::text
            ELSE 'N├úo resolvido'::text
        END AS tipo_frete,
    logistic_type,
    pedidos,
    COALESCE(unidades, 0::bigint) AS unidades,
    round(COALESCE(faturamento, 0::numeric), 2) AS faturamento,
    round(faturamento / NULLIF(pedidos, 0)::numeric, 2) AS ticket_medio,
    round(faturamento / NULLIF(unidades, 0)::numeric, 2) AS preco_medio,
    round(unidades::numeric / NULLIF(pedidos, 0)::numeric, 2) AS unid_por_pedido,
    produtos,
    round(COALESCE(comissao, 0::numeric), 2) AS comissao,
    round(100::numeric * comissao / NULLIF(faturamento, 0::numeric), 2) AS comissao_pct,
    round(100::numeric * pedidos_com_comissao::numeric / NULLIF(pedidos, 0)::numeric, 2) AS cobertura_comissao_pct,
    pedidos_cancelados,
    round(COALESCE(faturamento_cancelado, 0::numeric), 2) AS faturamento_cancelado,
    round(100::numeric * pedidos_cancelados::numeric / NULLIF(pedidos + pedidos_cancelados, 0)::numeric, 2) AS cancelamento_pct,
    round(100::numeric * faturamento / NULLIF(sum(faturamento) OVER (PARTITION BY data), 0::numeric), 2) AS share_pct
   FROM agg;

        ), i AS (

           FROM ml_product_ads_item_metricas
          GROUP BY ml_product_ads_item_metricas.date, ml_product_ads_item_metricas.advertiser_id
        ), b AS (

create or replace view public.vw_ml_tendencia_semana as
 WITH wk AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text))::date AS cur_week
        ), vend AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, fact_venda_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,
            sum(fact_venda_dia.venda_bruta) AS fat,
            sum(fact_venda_dia.pedidos) AS pedidos,
            sum(fact_venda_dia.unidades) AS unid
           FROM fact_venda_dia
          WHERE fact_venda_dia.data >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '56 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, fact_venda_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), disp AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.investimento) AS c,
            sum(vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.receita) AS r
           FROM vw_ml_display_campanha_dia
          WHERE vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '56 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_ml_display_campanha_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), brand AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_brand_ads_kpi_dia.date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_kpi_dia.cost) AS c,
            sum(vw_brand_ads_kpi_dia.receita) AS r
           FROM vw_brand_ads_kpi_dia
          WHERE vw_brand_ads_kpi_dia.date >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '56 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_brand_ads_kpi_dia.date::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), prod AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_ml_pads_kpi_dia.date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_kpi_dia.cost) AS c,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_kpi_dia.total_amount) AS r
           FROM vw_ml_pads_kpi_dia
          WHERE vw_ml_pads_kpi_dia.date >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '56 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_ml_pads_kpi_dia.date::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        )
 SELECT to_char(v.semana::timestamp with time zone, 'DD/MM'::text) AS semana,
    v.semana AS semana_ini,
    v.semana = (( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk)) AS parcial,
    v.semana >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk)) - '14 days'::interval) AS ads_maturando,
    round(v.fat) AS faturamento,
    v.unid AS unidades,
    v.pedidos,
    round(COALESCE(disp.c, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(brand.c, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(prod.c, 0::numeric)) AS invest_ads,
    round(v.fat / NULLIF(COALESCE(disp.c, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(brand.c, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(prod.c, 0::numeric), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_total,
    round(100.0 * (COALESCE(disp.c, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(brand.c, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(prod.c, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(v.fat, 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos_pct,
    round(COALESCE(prod.c, 0::numeric)) AS invest_product,
    round(prod.r / NULLIF(prod.c, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_product,
    round(COALESCE(disp.c, 0::numeric)) AS invest_display,
    round(disp.r / NULLIF(disp.c, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_display,
    round(COALESCE(brand.c, 0::numeric)) AS invest_brand,
    round(brand.r / NULLIF(brand.c, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_brand
   FROM vend v
     LEFT JOIN disp ON disp.semana = v.semana
     LEFT JOIN brand ON brand.semana = v.semana
     LEFT JOIN prod ON prod.semana = v.semana
  WHERE v.fat > 500000::numeric OR v.semana = (( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk))
  ORDER BY v.semana;

create or replace view public.vw_pads_campanhas as

create or replace view public.vw_pads_itens as
 SELECT "left"(title, 38) AS produto,
    round(sum(cost)) AS invest,
    round(sum(total_amount) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * sum(direct_units_quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(clicks), 0)::numeric, 1) AS cvr,
    bool_or(buy_box_winner) AS buy_box,
    max(logistic_type) AS logistica,
    round(100.0 * sum(indirect_amount) / NULLIF(sum(total_amount), 0::numeric)) AS pct_indireto,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(total_amount) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) >= 7.5 THEN ('SUBIR LANCE: ROAS '::text || round(sum(total_amount) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2)) || ' tem margem, ganhar volume no leilao'::text
            WHEN bool_or(buy_box_winner) IS FALSE AND max(logistic_type) = 'cross_docking'::text THEN ('Consertar buy box / migrar pro Full (ROAS '::text || round(sum(total_amount) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric), 2)) || ')'::text
            WHEN (100.0 * sum(indirect_amount) / NULLIF(sum(total_amount), 0::numeric)) >= 40::numeric THEN ('Halo alto ('::text || round(100.0 * sum(indirect_amount) / NULLIF(sum(total_amount), 0::numeric))) || '% indireto): reduzir com CAUTELA, nao pausar'::text
            WHEN (sum(total_amount) / NULLIF(sum(cost), 0::numeric)) < 6::numeric THEN 'Abaixo de 7: melhorar preco/listagem/keywords internas (nao verba)'::text
            ELSE 'Manter'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM vw_ml_pads_item_dia
  WHERE date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
  GROUP BY title
 HAVING sum(cost) > 100::numeric
  ORDER BY (round(sum(cost))) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_pads_resumo as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.cost) AS inv,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.total_amount) AS rec,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.units_quantity) AS un,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.indirect_amount) AS ind,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.lost_impression_share_by_ad_rank * vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.prints::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.prints), 0::numeric) AS lr,
            sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.lost_impression_share_by_budget * vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.prints::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.prints), 0::numeric) AS lb
           FROM vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia
          WHERE vw_ml_pads_campanha_dia.date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
        )
 SELECT metrica,
    valor,
    sugestao
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS ord,
            'Investimento'::text AS metrica,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(p.inv), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS valor,
            'Maior formato do ML'::text AS sugestao
           FROM p
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 2,
            'ROAS'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(p.rec / NULLIF(p.inv, 0::numeric), 2), 'FM990.00'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) AS replace,
            'Meta 7 SEM perder volume'::text AS text
           FROM p
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 3,
            'Unidades'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(p.un, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS replace,
            'Volume - nao sacrificar pra inflar ROAS'::text AS text
           FROM p
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 4,
            '% indireto (halo)'::text AS text,
            replace(to_char(round(100::numeric * p.ind / NULLIF(p.rec, 0::numeric), 1), 'FM990.0'::text), '.'::text, ','::text) || '%'::text,
            'Vendas que o ad puxa de outros produtos'::text AS text
           FROM p
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 5,
            'Perde impressao por ORCAMENTO'::text AS text,
            to_char(round(100::numeric * p.lb), 'FM990'::text) || '%'::text,
            'Se ~0: verba NAO e o gargalo'::text AS text
           FROM p
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 6,
            'Perde impressao por AD RANK'::text AS text,
            to_char(round(100::numeric * p.lr), 'FM990'::text) || '%'::text,
            'Gargalo real: ganhar via buy box/preco/lance'::text AS text
           FROM p) t
  ORDER BY ord;

create or replace view public.vw_pl_canal_dia as
 WITH ml_fee AS (
         SELECT ml_pedido_item.pedido_id,
            sum(ml_pedido_item.sale_fee * ml_pedido_item.quantity::numeric) AS fee
           FROM ml_pedido_item
          GROUP BY ml_pedido_item.pedido_id
        ), ml_base AS (
         SELECT p_1.data_venda AS data,
            sum(p_1.total_amount) AS receita,
            sum(COALESCE(f.fee, 0::numeric)) AS taxa_real,
            sum(p_1.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(f.fee, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric) AS receita_com_taxa
           FROM ml_pedido p_1
             LEFT JOIN ml_fee f USING (pedido_id)
          WHERE p_1.status <> 'cancelled'::text
          GROUP BY p_1.data_venda
        ), ml_afil AS (
         SELECT ml_afiliado_venda.data_venda AS data,
            sum(ml_afiliado_venda.comissao_pedido) AS afiliado
           FROM ml_afiliado_venda
          GROUP BY ml_afiliado_venda.data_venda
        ), ml AS (
         SELECT b.data,
            'Mercado Livre'::text AS canal,
            b.receita,
            b.taxa_real + (b.receita - COALESCE(b.receita_com_taxa, 0::numeric)) * COALESCE(( SELECT dim_param_canal.taxa_mkt_estimada_pct
                   FROM dim_param_canal
                  WHERE dim_param_canal.canal = 'Mercado Livre'::text), 0::numeric) / 100::numeric AS det_taxa,
            COALESCE(a.afiliado, 0::numeric) AS det_afiliado,
            0::numeric AS det_frete,
            'parcial'::text AS qualidade,
            round(100.0 * COALESCE(b.receita_com_taxa, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(b.receita, 0::numeric), 1) AS cobertura_pct,
            b.receita * COALESCE(( SELECT dim_param_canal.taxa_mkt_estimada_pct
                   FROM dim_param_canal
                  WHERE dim_param_canal.canal = 'Mercado Livre'::text), 0::numeric) / 100::numeric + COALESCE(a.afiliado, 0::numeric) AS custo_canal_ref
           FROM ml_base b
             LEFT JOIN ml_afil a USING (data)
        ), sp_base AS (
         SELECT p_1.create_dia AS data,
            sum(p_1.total_amount) AS receita,
            sum(p_1.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE f.escrow_amount > 0::numeric) AS receita_liquidada,
            sum(f.escrow_amount) FILTER (WHERE f.escrow_amount > 0::numeric) AS liquidado,
            sum(COALESCE(f.commission_fee, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(f.service_fee, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(f.seller_transaction_fee, 0::numeric)) AS det_taxa,
            sum(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric)) AS det_afiliado,
            sum(- COALESCE(f.final_shipping_fee, 0::numeric)) AS det_frete
           FROM shopee_pedido p_1
             LEFT JOIN fact_shopee_financeiro f USING (order_sn)
          WHERE p_1.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'::text
          GROUP BY p_1.create_dia
        ), sp AS (
         SELECT sp_base.data,
            'Shopee'::text AS canal,
            sp_base.receita,
            sp_base.det_taxa,
            sp_base.det_afiliado,
            sp_base.det_frete,
            'liquidacao'::text AS qualidade,
            round(100.0 * COALESCE(sp_base.receita_liquidada, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(sp_base.receita, 0::numeric), 1) AS cobertura_pct,
            sp_base.receita * ((COALESCE(sp_base.receita_liquidada, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(sp_base.liquidado, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(sp_base.receita_liquidada, 0::numeric)) AS custo_liquidacao
           FROM sp_base
        ), tk_base AS (
         SELECT p_1.create_dia AS data,
            sum(p_1.total_amount) AS receita,
            sum(p_1.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE f.settlement IS NOT NULL) AS receita_liquidada,
            sum(f.settlement) AS liquidado,
            sum(- COALESCE(f.taxas_total, 0::numeric)) AS det_taxa,
            sum(- (COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado_ads, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(f.comissao_parceiro, 0::numeric))) AS det_afiliado,
            sum(- COALESCE(f.frete_custo, 0::numeric)) AS det_frete
           FROM tiktok_pedido p_1
             LEFT JOIN fact_tiktok_financeiro f ON f.order_id = p_1.order_id
          WHERE p_1.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text
          GROUP BY p_1.create_dia
        ), tk AS (
         SELECT tk_base.data,
            'TikTok'::text AS canal,
            tk_base.receita,
            tk_base.det_taxa,
            tk_base.det_afiliado,
            tk_base.det_frete,
            'liquidacao'::text AS qualidade,
            round(100.0 * COALESCE(tk_base.receita_liquidada, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(tk_base.receita, 0::numeric), 1) AS cobertura_pct,
            tk_base.receita * ((COALESCE(tk_base.receita_liquidada, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(tk_base.liquidado, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(tk_base.receita_liquidada, 0::numeric)) AS custo_liquidacao
           FROM tk_base
        ), amz_asin AS (
         SELECT fact_amazon_venda_asin_dia.data,
            sum(fact_amazon_venda_asin_dia.vendas) AS vendas
           FROM fact_amazon_venda_asin_dia
          GROUP BY fact_amazon_venda_asin_dia.data
        ), amz_traf AS (
         SELECT fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia.data,
            sum(fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia.vendas) AS vendas
           FROM fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia
          GROUP BY fact_amazon_venda_trafego_dia.data
        ), am AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(a.data, t.data) AS data,
            'Amazon'::text AS canal,
            COALESCE(a.vendas, t.vendas * (( SELECT dim_param_canal.receita_gross_up
                   FROM dim_param_canal
                  WHERE dim_param_canal.canal = 'Amazon'::text))) AS receita,
            0::numeric AS det_taxa,
            0::numeric AS det_afiliado,
            0::numeric AS det_frete,
            'ausente'::text AS qualidade,
            0::numeric AS cobertura_pct
           FROM amz_asin a
             FULL JOIN amz_traf t USING (data)
        ), sh_ped AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id) stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id,
            stg_shopify_orders_item.date,
            stg_shopify_orders_item.order_total_price
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item
          WHERE stg_shopify_orders_item.order_cancelled_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_test, false) = false
        ), sh AS (
         SELECT sh_ped.date AS data,
            'Site'::text AS canal,
            sum(sh_ped.order_total_price) AS receita,
            0::numeric AS det_taxa,
            0::numeric AS det_afiliado,
            0::numeric AS det_frete,
            'ausente'::text AS qualidade,
            0::numeric AS cobertura_pct
           FROM sh_ped
          GROUP BY sh_ped.date
        ), canais AS (
         SELECT ml.data,
            ml.canal,
            ml.receita,
            ml.det_taxa,
            ml.det_afiliado,
            ml.det_frete,
            ml.qualidade,
            ml.cobertura_pct,
            ml.det_taxa + ml.det_afiliado + ml.det_frete AS custo_canal,
            ml.custo_canal_ref
           FROM ml
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sp.data,
            sp.canal,
            sp.receita,
            sp.det_taxa,
            sp.det_afiliado,
            sp.det_frete,
            sp.qualidade,
            sp.cobertura_pct,
            sp.custo_liquidacao,
            NULL::numeric AS "numeric"
           FROM sp
        UNION ALL
         SELECT tk.data,
            tk.canal,
            tk.receita,
            tk.det_taxa,
            tk.det_afiliado,
            tk.det_frete,
            tk.qualidade,
            tk.cobertura_pct,
            tk.custo_liquidacao,
            NULL::numeric AS "numeric"
           FROM tk
        UNION ALL
         SELECT am.data,
            am.canal,
            am.receita,
            am.det_taxa,
            am.det_afiliado,
            am.det_frete,
            am.qualidade,
            am.cobertura_pct,
            am.receita * COALESCE(( SELECT dim_param_canal.taxa_mkt_estimada_pct
                   FROM dim_param_canal
                  WHERE dim_param_canal.canal = 'Amazon'::text), 0::numeric) / 100::numeric,
            NULL::numeric AS "numeric"
           FROM am
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sh.data,
            sh.canal,
            sh.receita,
            sh.det_taxa,
            sh.det_afiliado,
            sh.det_frete,
            sh.qualidade,
            sh.cobertura_pct,
            sh.receita * COALESCE(( SELECT dim_param_canal.taxa_mkt_estimada_pct
                   FROM dim_param_canal
                  WHERE dim_param_canal.canal = 'Site'::text), 0::numeric) / 100::numeric,
            NULL::numeric AS "numeric"
           FROM sh
        ), cmv AS (
         SELECT u.data,
            u.canal,
            sum(u.unidades * c_1.custo_unitario) AS cmv,
            sum(u.receita_item) FILTER (WHERE c_1.custo_unitario IS NOT NULL) AS receita_com_custo,
            sum(u.receita_item) AS receita_itens
           FROM vw_unidades_canal_dia u
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.custo_unitario
                   FROM dim_custo_sku d
                  WHERE d.sku = u.sku AND d.vigencia_inicio <= u.data
                  ORDER BY d.vigencia_inicio DESC
                 LIMIT 1) c_1 ON true
          GROUP BY u.data, u.canal
        )
 SELECT c.data,
    c.canal,
    round(c.receita, 2) AS receita_bruta,
    round(COALESCE(c.custo_canal, 0::numeric), 2) AS custo_canal,
    round(c.det_taxa, 2) AS det_taxa,
    round(c.det_afiliado, 2) AS det_afiliado,
    round(c.det_frete, 2) AS det_frete,
    round(COALESCE(r.invest_ads, 0::numeric), 2) AS ads,
    round(c.receita * p.imposto_pct / 100::numeric, 2) AS imposto,
    round(COALESCE(m.cmv, 0::numeric), 2) AS cmv,
    round(c.receita - COALESCE(c.custo_canal, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(r.invest_ads, 0::numeric) - c.receita * p.imposto_pct / 100::numeric - COALESCE(m.cmv, 0::numeric), 2) AS margem_contribuicao,
    round(100.0 * (c.receita - COALESCE(c.custo_canal, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(r.invest_ads, 0::numeric) - c.receita * p.imposto_pct / 100::numeric - COALESCE(m.cmv, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(c.receita, 0::numeric), 1) AS margem_pct,
    c.qualidade AS qualidade_taxa,
    c.cobertura_pct,
    m.cmv IS NOT NULL AND m.cmv > 0::numeric AS cmv_carregado,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(m.receita_com_custo, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(m.receita_itens, 0::numeric), 1) AS cmv_cobertura_pct,
    round(c.custo_canal_ref, 2) AS custo_canal_ref,
    p.imposto_pct
   FROM canais c
     JOIN dim_param_canal p ON p.canal = c.canal
     LEFT JOIN fact_receita_diaria r ON r.data = c.data AND r.canal_venda = c.canal
     LEFT JOIN cmv m ON m.data = c.data AND m.canal = c.canal
  WHERE c.receita IS NOT NULL;

create or replace view public.vw_pl_canal_mes as
 SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes,
    canal,
    round(sum(receita_bruta), 2) AS receita_bruta,
    round(sum(custo_canal), 2) AS custo_canal,
    round(100.0 * sum(custo_canal) / NULLIF(sum(receita_bruta), 0::numeric), 1) AS custo_canal_pct,
    round(sum(det_taxa), 2) AS det_taxa,
    round(sum(det_afiliado), 2) AS det_afiliado,
    round(sum(det_frete), 2) AS det_frete,
    round(sum(ads), 2) AS ads,
    round(100.0 * sum(ads) / NULLIF(sum(receita_bruta), 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos_pct,
    round(sum(imposto), 2) AS imposto,
    round(sum(cmv), 2) AS cmv,
    round(sum(margem_contribuicao), 2) AS margem_contribuicao,
    round(100.0 * sum(margem_contribuicao) / NULLIF(sum(receita_bruta), 0::numeric), 1) AS margem_pct,
    round(sum(custo_canal_ref), 2) AS custo_canal_ref,
    round(sum(receita_bruta) - sum(custo_canal_ref) - sum(ads) - sum(imposto) - sum(cmv), 2) AS margem_cenario_ref,
    max(qualidade_taxa) AS qualidade_taxa,
    round(sum(cobertura_pct * receita_bruta) / NULLIF(sum(receita_bruta), 0::numeric), 1) AS cobertura_pct,
    bool_or(cmv_carregado) AS cmv_carregado
   FROM mv_pl_canal_dia
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, data::timestamp with time zone)::date), canal;

create or replace view public.vw_receita_consolidada as
 SELECT data,
    canal_venda AS canal,
    receita_total AS faturamento,
    pedidos,
    round(100.0 * receita_total / NULLIF(sum(receita_total) OVER (PARTITION BY data), 0::numeric), 1) AS share_pct,
    invest_ads,
    receita_ads,
    COALESCE(invest_afiliados, 0::numeric) AS invest_afiliados,
    COALESCE(invest_ads, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(invest_afiliados, 0::numeric) AS invest_aquisicao,
    round(receita_ads / NULLIF(invest_ads, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_ads,
    round(100.0 * invest_ads / NULLIF(receita_ads, 0::numeric), 1) AS acos_pct,
    round(receita_total / NULLIF(invest_ads, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_total,
    round(100.0 * invest_ads / NULLIF(receita_total, 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos_pct,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(invest_afiliados, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(receita_total, 0::numeric), 1) AS afiliado_pct,
    round(100.0 * (COALESCE(invest_ads, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(invest_afiliados, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(receita_total, 0::numeric), 1) AS aquisicao_pct,
    canal_venda = ANY (ARRAY['Shopee'::text, 'TikTok'::text]) AS tem_afiliado,
    data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 8) OR (canal_venda <> ALL (ARRAY['Shopee'::text, 'TikTok'::text])) AS afiliado_maturado,
    carregado_em
   FROM fact_receita_diaria;

create or replace view public.vw_receita_consolidada_dia as

    round(sum(receita_ads) / NULLIF(sum(invest_ads), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_ads,

create or replace view public.vw_reconciliacao_shopify_meta_dia as
 WITH pedidos_dia AS (
         SELECT vw_site_pedido_classe.data,
            count(*) AS pedidos_totais,
            sum(vw_site_pedido_classe.pago) AS receita_pedidos_totais
           FROM vw_site_pedido_classe
          GROUP BY vw_site_pedido_classe.data
        ), pedidos_meta_utm_dia AS (
         SELECT vw_site_venda_midia_pedido.data,
            count(*) AS pedidos_meta_utm,
            sum(vw_site_venda_midia_pedido.receita) AS receita_meta_utm
           FROM vw_site_venda_midia_pedido
          WHERE vw_site_venda_midia_pedido.fonte = 'Meta'::text
          GROUP BY vw_site_venda_midia_pedido.data
        ), enviados_dia AS (
         SELECT (eventos_conversao_enviados.enviado_em AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date AS data,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE eventos_conversao_enviados.plataforma = 'meta'::text AND eventos_conversao_enviados.status_envio = 'sucesso'::text) AS enviados_meta,
            sum(eventos_conversao_enviados.valor) FILTER (WHERE eventos_conversao_enviados.plataforma = 'meta'::text AND eventos_conversao_enviados.status_envio = 'sucesso'::text) AS valor_enviado_meta
           FROM eventos_conversao_enviados
          GROUP BY ((eventos_conversao_enviados.enviado_em AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date)
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(m.data, p.data, pm.data, e.data) AS data,
    p.pedidos_totais,
    pm.pedidos_meta_utm,
    pm.receita_meta_utm,
    e.enviados_meta,
    e.valor_enviado_meta,
    m.gasto AS gasto_meta,
    m.compras AS compras_informadas_meta,
    m.receita AS receita_informada_meta,
    m.compras - e.enviados_meta::numeric AS diferenca_nao_reconciliada,
        CASE
            WHEN m.compras > 0::numeric THEN round(e.enviados_meta::numeric / m.compras, 3)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS taxa_reconciliacao,
    p.receita_pedidos_totais
   FROM vw_meta_kpi_dia m
     FULL JOIN pedidos_dia p ON p.data = m.data
     FULL JOIN pedidos_meta_utm_dia pm ON pm.data = m.data
     FULL JOIN enviados_dia e ON e.data = m.data
  ORDER BY (COALESCE(m.data, p.data, pm.data, e.data)) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_saude_amazon as
 WITH o AS (
         SELECT fact_amazon_pedido.amazon_order_id AS oid,
            min(fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_date) AS compra,
            max(fact_amazon_pedido.order_status) AS status,
            bool_or(fact_amazon_pedido.fulfillment_channel = 'Merchant'::text) AS fbm,
            round(sum(fact_amazon_pedido.item_price)) AS valor
           FROM fact_amazon_pedido
          WHERE fact_amazon_pedido.purchase_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 45)
          GROUP BY fact_amazon_pedido.amazon_order_id
        )
 SELECT 'Amazon'::text AS canal,
    oid AS pedido,
    compra::date AS data,
    CURRENT_DATE - compra::date AS dias_aberto,
    valor,
        CASE
            WHEN status ~~* 'Pending%'::text AND fbm AND (CURRENT_DATE - compra::date) >= 2 THEN 'Atrasado - nao enviado'::text
            WHEN status ~~* 'Pending%'::text THEN 'Pendente de envio'::text
            WHEN status = 'Cancelled'::text THEN 'Cancelado'::text
            WHEN status ~~* '%Return%'::text OR status ~~* '%Reject%'::text THEN 'Devolucao'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS problema,
        CASE
            WHEN status ~~* 'Pending%'::text AND fbm AND (CURRENT_DATE - compra::date) >= 2 THEN 'Alta'::text
            WHEN status = 'Cancelled'::text OR status ~~* '%Return%'::text OR status ~~* '%Reject%'::text THEN 'Media'::text
            ELSE 'Baixa'::text
        END AS severidade
   FROM o
  WHERE status ~~* 'Pending%'::text OR status = 'Cancelled'::text OR status ~~* '%Return%'::text OR status ~~* '%Reject%'::text;

create or replace view public.vw_saude_ml as
 WITH o AS (
         SELECT ml_pedido.pedido_id,
            ml_pedido.data_venda,
            ml_pedido.date_created,
            ml_pedido.status,
            ml_pedido.tags::text AS tg,
            round(ml_pedido.total_amount) AS valor
           FROM ml_pedido
          WHERE ml_pedido.data_venda >= (CURRENT_DATE - 45)
        )
 SELECT 'Mercado Livre'::text AS canal,
    pedido_id::text AS pedido,
    data_venda AS data,
    CURRENT_DATE - date_created::date AS dias_aberto,
    valor,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'cancelled'::text THEN 'Cancelado'::text
            WHEN status = 'partially_refunded'::text THEN 'Reembolso parcial'::text
            WHEN tg ~~* '%not_paid%'::text THEN 'Nao pago'::text
            WHEN tg ~~* '%not_delivered%'::text AND status = 'paid'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - date_created::date) >= 12 THEN 'Atrasado - nao entregue'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS problema,
        CASE
            WHEN tg ~~* '%not_delivered%'::text AND status = 'paid'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - date_created::date) >= 12 THEN 'Alta'::text
            WHEN (status = ANY (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'partially_refunded'::text])) OR tg ~~* '%not_paid%'::text THEN 'Media'::text
            ELSE 'Baixa'::text
        END AS severidade
   FROM o
  WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'partially_refunded'::text])) OR tg ~~* '%not_paid%'::text OR tg ~~* '%not_delivered%'::text AND status = 'paid'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - date_created::date) >= 12;

create or replace view public.vw_saude_shopify as
 WITH o AS (
         SELECT stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_name) AS nome,
            min(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_created_at) AS criado,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_fulfillment_status) AS fs,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_financial_status) AS fin,
            bool_or(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancelado,
            round(max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_total_price)) AS valor
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item
          WHERE stg_shopify_orders_item.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 45) AND NOT COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_test, false)
          GROUP BY stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id
        )
 SELECT 'Site'::text AS canal,
    nome AS pedido,
    criado::date AS data,
    CURRENT_DATE - criado::date AS dias_aberto,
    valor,
        CASE
            WHEN cancelado THEN 'Cancelado'::text
            WHEN fin = ANY (ARRAY['REFUNDED'::text, 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'::text]) THEN 'Reembolsado'::text
            WHEN fin = ANY (ARRAY['EXPIRED'::text, 'PARTIALLY_PAID'::text]) THEN 'Nao pago'::text
            WHEN fs = 'UNFULFILLED'::text AND fin = 'PAID'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - criado::date) >= 2 THEN 'Atrasado - nao enviado'::text
            WHEN fs = 'PARTIALLY_FULFILLED'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - criado::date) >= 2 THEN 'Parcialmente enviado'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS problema,
        CASE
            WHEN fs = 'UNFULFILLED'::text AND fin = 'PAID'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - criado::date) >= 2 THEN 'Alta'::text
            WHEN cancelado OR (fin = ANY (ARRAY['REFUNDED'::text, 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'::text, 'EXPIRED'::text, 'PARTIALLY_PAID'::text])) THEN 'Media'::text
            ELSE 'Baixa'::text
        END AS severidade
   FROM o
  WHERE cancelado OR (fin = ANY (ARRAY['REFUNDED'::text, 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'::text, 'EXPIRED'::text, 'PARTIALLY_PAID'::text])) OR fs = 'UNFULFILLED'::text AND fin = 'PAID'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - criado::date) >= 2 OR fs = 'PARTIALLY_FULFILLED'::text AND (CURRENT_DATE - criado::date) >= 2;
