create or replace view public.vw_shopee_ads_cobertura_dia as
 SELECT t.data,
    round(t.expense, 2) AS investimento_total,
    round(COALESCE(c.expense_campanhas, 0::numeric), 2) AS investimento_em_campanhas,
    round(t.expense - COALESCE(c.expense_campanhas, 0::numeric), 2) AS investimento_nao_atribuido,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(c.expense_campanhas, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(t.expense, 0::numeric), 1) AS pct_atribuido,
    COALESCE(c.campanhas_ativas, 0::bigint) AS campanhas_com_gasto,
    round(t.direct_gmv, 2) AS gmv_direto_total,
    round(COALESCE(c.gmv_campanhas, 0::numeric), 2) AS gmv_direto_campanhas
   FROM fact_shopee_ads_total_dia t
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.data,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.expense) AS expense_campanhas,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.direct_gmv) AS gmv_campanhas,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.expense > 0::numeric) AS campanhas_ativas
           FROM fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia
          GROUP BY fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.data) c ON c.data = t.data;

create or replace view public.vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia as
 WITH camp AS (
         SELECT fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.data,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.campaign_placement, ''::text), 'outros'::text) AS tipo,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.expense) AS investimento,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.direct_gmv) AS receita,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.impression) AS impressoes,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.clicks) AS cliques,
            sum(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.direct_order) AS unidades
           FROM fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia
          GROUP BY fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.data, (COALESCE(NULLIF(fact_shopee_ads_campanha_dia.campaign_placement, ''::text), 'outros'::text))
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT fact_shopee_ads_total_dia.data,
            fact_shopee_ads_total_dia.expense,
            fact_shopee_ads_total_dia.direct_gmv,
            fact_shopee_ads_total_dia.impression,
            fact_shopee_ads_total_dia.clicks
           FROM fact_shopee_ads_total_dia
        ), resto AS (
         SELECT t.data,
            'nao atribuido'::text AS tipo,
            GREATEST(t.expense - COALESCE(c.inv, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS investimento,
            GREATEST(t.direct_gmv - COALESCE(c.rec, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS receita,
            GREATEST(t.impression::numeric - COALESCE(c.imp, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS impressoes,
            GREATEST(t.clicks::numeric - COALESCE(c.cli, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS cliques,
            NULL::bigint AS unidades
           FROM tot t
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT camp.data,
                    sum(camp.investimento) AS inv,
                    sum(camp.receita) AS rec,
                    sum(camp.impressoes) AS imp,
                    sum(camp.cliques) AS cli
                   FROM camp
                  GROUP BY camp.data) c ON c.data = t.data
          WHERE GREATEST(t.expense - COALESCE(c.inv, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) > 0::numeric
        )
 SELECT camp.data,
    camp.tipo,
    camp.investimento,
    camp.receita,
    camp.impressoes,
    camp.cliques,
    camp.unidades
   FROM camp
UNION ALL
 SELECT resto.data,
    resto.tipo,
    resto.investimento,
    resto.receita,
    resto.impressoes,
    resto.cliques,
    resto.unidades
   FROM resto;

create or replace view public.vw_shopee_afiliado_dia as

    round(sum(order_selling_price), 2) AS gmv_total,
    round(sum(order_selling_price) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric), 2) AS gmv_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * sum(order_selling_price) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(order_selling_price), 0::numeric), 2) AS pct_gmv_afiliado,
    round(sum(comissao_afiliado), 2) AS custo_afiliado,

    round(avg(order_selling_price) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric), 2) AS ticket_afiliado,

    round(100.0 * sum(escrow_amount) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(order_selling_price) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric), 0::numeric), 2) AS margem_sem_afiliado_pct

create or replace view public.vw_shopee_afiliado_produto_dia as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT f.order_sn,
            f.create_dia,
            f.comissao_afiliado,
            f.order_selling_price
           FROM fact_shopee_financeiro f
        ), item AS (
         SELECT p.create_dia AS data,
            p.order_sn,
            p.comissao_afiliado,
            i.item_id,
            i.item_sku,
            i.item_name,
            i.model_quantity_purchased AS qtd,
            COALESCE(i.model_discounted_price, 0::numeric) * COALESCE(i.model_quantity_purchased, 0)::numeric AS valor_item,
            p.order_selling_price
           FROM ped p
             JOIN shopee_pedido_item i ON i.order_sn = p.order_sn
        ), rateado AS (
         SELECT it.data,
            it.order_sn,
            it.comissao_afiliado,
            it.item_id,
            it.item_sku,
            it.item_name,
            it.qtd,
            it.valor_item,
            it.order_selling_price,
            sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_sn) AS valor_pedido,
                CASE
                    WHEN sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_sn) > 0::numeric THEN it.comissao_afiliado * (it.valor_item / sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_sn))
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS custo_afiliado_rateado,
                CASE
                    WHEN sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_sn) > 0::numeric THEN it.order_selling_price * (it.valor_item / sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_sn))
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS gmv_rateado
           FROM item it
        )
 SELECT data,
    item_id,
    item_sku,
    max(item_name) AS produto,
    count(DISTINCT order_sn) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric) AS pedidos_afiliado,
    sum(qtd) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric) AS unidades_afiliado,
    round(sum(gmv_rateado) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric), 2) AS gmv_afiliado,
    round(sum(custo_afiliado_rateado), 2) AS custo_afiliado,
    count(DISTINCT order_sn) AS pedidos_total,
    round(sum(gmv_rateado), 2) AS gmv_total,
    round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT order_sn) FILTER (WHERE comissao_afiliado > 0::numeric)::numeric / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT order_sn), 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_pedidos_via_afiliado
   FROM rateado
  GROUP BY data, item_id, item_sku;

create or replace view public.vw_shopee_frete_pedido as
 SELECT p.create_dia AS data,

    p.order_sn AS pedido_id,
    to_char((to_timestamp(p.create_time::double precision) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text), 'HH24:MI'::text) AS hora,
    p.order_status AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN p.order_status = 'CANCELLED'::text THEN 'Cancelado'::text
            ELSE 'V├ílido'::text
        END AS situacao,
    p.payment_method AS pagamento,

create or replace view public.vw_shopee_visao_geral_dia as
 WITH venda AS (
         SELECT fact_shopee_venda_dia.data,
            fact_shopee_venda_dia.faturamento AS venda_total,
            fact_shopee_venda_dia.pedidos::bigint AS pedidos_total,

            fact_shopee_venda_dia.ticket_medio
           FROM fact_shopee_venda_dia
        ), liquido AS (
         SELECT fact_shopee_financeiro.create_dia AS data,
            round(sum(fact_shopee_financeiro.escrow_amount), 2) AS venda_total_paga
           FROM fact_shopee_financeiro
          GROUP BY fact_shopee_financeiro.create_dia
        ), ads AS (
         SELECT vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia.data,
            sum(vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia.investimento) AS invest_ads,
            sum(vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia.receita) AS receita_ads,
            sum(vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia.impressoes)::bigint AS impressoes_ads,
            sum(vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia.cliques)::bigint AS cliques_ads
           FROM vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia
          GROUP BY vw_shopee_ads_por_tipo_dia.data
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(v.data, a.data) AS data,
    v.venda_total,
    l.venda_total_paga,
    v.pedidos_total,
    v.unidades_vendidas,
    a.invest_ads,
    a.receita_ads,
    a.impressoes_ads,
    a.cliques_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN v.venda_total > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * a.receita_ads / v.venda_total, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS share_ads_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN a.invest_ads > 0::numeric THEN round(a.receita_ads / a.invest_ads, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN a.invest_ads > 0::numeric THEN round(v.venda_total / a.invest_ads, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas_total,
        CASE
            WHEN a.receita_ads > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * a.invest_ads / a.receita_ads, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS acos_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN v.venda_total > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * a.invest_ads / v.venda_total, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS acos_total,
    NULL::bigint AS visitas,
    NULL::numeric AS conversao_pct,
    v.ticket_medio
   FROM venda v
     FULL JOIN ads a ON a.data = v.data

create or replace view public.vw_site_cupom_dia as
 WITH ord AS (
         SELECT stg_shopify_orders_item.date AS data,
            stg_shopify_orders_item.order_discount_code AS cupom,
            stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_gross_sales) AS gross,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_net_sales) AS net,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_total_price) AS pago,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_total_discounts) AS desconto,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_returns_amount) AS devol,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_returns_quantity) AS devol_qtd,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_total_shipping_price) AS frete,
            max(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_number_of_orders) AS n_orders,
            sum(stg_shopify_orders_item.line_item__quantity) AS unidades
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item
          WHERE COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_discount_code, ''::text) <> ''::text AND COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_test, false) = false AND stg_shopify_orders_item.order_cancelled_at IS NULL
          GROUP BY stg_shopify_orders_item.date, stg_shopify_orders_item.order_discount_code, stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id
        )
 SELECT data,
    cupom,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_orders = 1::numeric) AS pedidos_cliente_novo,
    sum(unidades) AS unidades,
    round(sum(gross), 2) AS faturamento_bruto,
    round(sum(net), 2) AS faturamento_liquido,
    round(sum(pago), 2) AS total_pago,
    round(sum(desconto), 2) AS desconto,
    round(sum(devol), 2) AS devolucoes,
    sum(devol_qtd) AS unidades_devolvidas,
    round(sum(frete), 2) AS frete,
    round(sum(gross) + sum(COALESCE(frete, 0::numeric)), 2) AS base_desconto,
    round(100.0 * sum(desconto) / NULLIF(sum(gross) + sum(COALESCE(frete, 0::numeric)), 0::numeric), 1) AS desconto_pct,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE net < 1::numeric) AS pedidos_permuta,
    COALESCE(sum(unidades) FILTER (WHERE net < 1::numeric), 0::bigint::numeric) AS unidades_permuta,
    round(COALESCE(sum(desconto) FILTER (WHERE net < 1::numeric), 0::numeric), 2) AS desconto_permuta
   FROM ord
  GROUP BY data, cupom;

create or replace view public.vw_site_pagina as
 WITH observadas AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT fact_site_pagina_dia.pagina_path
           FROM fact_site_pagina_dia

         SELECT DISTINCT '/'::text || regexp_replace(split_part(split_part(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page, '?'::text, 1), '://'::text, 2), '^[^/]+/'::text, ''::text)
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item
          WHERE stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page ~~* '%/pages/%'::text OR stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page ~~* '%/products/%'::text
        ), limpo AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(observadas.pagina_path, '/+$'::text, ''::text) AS pagina_path
           FROM observadas
          WHERE observadas.pagina_path IS NOT NULL AND observadas.pagina_path <> ''::text
        )
 SELECT l.pagina_path,
    p.produto,
    p.ordem AS produto_ordem,
        CASE
            WHEN l.pagina_path = ('/products/'::text || p.pdp_handle) THEN 'PDP'::text
            ELSE 'Pagina'::text
        END AS tipo,
        CASE
            WHEN l.pagina_path = ('/products/'::text || p.pdp_handle) THEN 'Pagina do produto (PDP)'::text
            ELSE initcap(replace(regexp_replace(split_part(l.pagina_path, '/pages/'::text, 2), '^'::text || p.lp_prefixo, ''::text), '-'::text, ' '::text))
        END AS rotulo
   FROM limpo l
     JOIN dim_site_produto_pagina p ON l.pagina_path = ('/products/'::text || p.pdp_handle) OR l.pagina_path ~~ (('/pages/'::text || p.lp_prefixo) || '%'::text)
  WHERE p.ativo;

create or replace view public.vw_site_pagina_canal_dia as
 WITH chaves AS (
         SELECT fact_site_pagina_canal_dia.pagina_path,

            fact_site_pagina_canal_dia.utm_source,
            fact_site_pagina_canal_dia.utm_medium
           FROM fact_site_pagina_canal_dia
        UNION
         SELECT mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia.pagina_path,
            mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia.data,
            mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia.utm_source,
            mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia.utm_medium
           FROM mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia
        )
 SELECT pg.produto,
    pg.produto_ordem,
    pg.tipo,
    pg.rotulo,
    pg.pagina_path,
    k.data,
    site_canal(k.utm_source, k.utm_medium) AS canal,
    k.utm_source,
    k.utm_medium,
    COALESCE(s.sessoes, 0) AS sessoes,
    COALESCE(s.sessoes_checkout, 0) AS sessoes_checkout,
    COALESCE(p.pedidos, 0) AS pedidos,
    COALESCE(p.receita, 0::numeric) AS receita,
    COALESCE(p.unidades, 0) AS unidades
   FROM chaves k
     JOIN vw_site_pagina pg ON pg.pagina_path = k.pagina_path
     LEFT JOIN fact_site_pagina_canal_dia s ON s.pagina_path = k.pagina_path AND s.data = k.data AND s.utm_source = k.utm_source AND s.utm_medium = k.utm_medium
     LEFT JOIN mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia p ON p.pagina_path = k.pagina_path AND p.data = k.data AND p.utm_source = k.utm_source AND p.utm_medium = k.utm_medium;

create or replace view public.vw_site_pagina_resumo as
 WITH lim AS (
         SELECT max(fact_site_pagina_canal_dia.data) AS dmax
           FROM fact_site_pagina_canal_dia
        ), b AS (
         SELECT d.produto,
            d.produto_ordem,
            d.tipo,
            d.rotulo,
            d.pagina_path,
            d.data,
            d.sessoes,
            d.sessoes_checkout,
            d.pedidos,
            d.receita,
            d.unidades,
            e.estreia_paginas
           FROM vw_site_pagina_dia d
             JOIN vw_site_produto_estreia e ON e.produto = d.produto
             CROSS JOIN lim
          WHERE d.data >= e.estreia_paginas AND d.data <= lim.dmax
        )
 SELECT produto,
    produto_ordem,
    tipo,
    rotulo,
    pagina_path,
    min(data) FILTER (WHERE sessoes > 0 OR pedidos > 0) AS primeiro_dia,
    max(data) FILTER (WHERE sessoes > 0 OR pedidos > 0) AS ultimo_dia,
    sum(sessoes) AS sessoes,
    sum(sessoes_checkout) AS sessoes_checkout,
    sum(pedidos) AS pedidos,
    round(sum(receita), 2) AS receita,
    sum(unidades) AS unidades,
    round(100.0 * sum(pedidos)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes), 0)::numeric, 2) AS conversao_pct,
    round(sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(pedidos), 0)::numeric, 2) AS ticket_medio,
    round(sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(sessoes), 0)::numeric, 2) AS receita_por_sessao
   FROM b
  GROUP BY produto, produto_ordem, tipo, rotulo, pagina_path;

create or replace view public.vw_site_produto_resumo as
 WITH lim AS (
         SELECT max(fact_site_pagina_canal_dia.data) AS dmax
           FROM fact_site_pagina_canal_dia
        ), b AS (
         SELECT d.produto,
            d.produto_ordem,
            d.tipo,
            d.rotulo,
            d.pagina_path,
            d.data,
            d.sessoes,
            d.sessoes_checkout,
            d.pedidos,
            d.receita,
            d.unidades,
            e.estreia_paginas
           FROM vw_site_pagina_dia d
             JOIN vw_site_produto_estreia e ON e.produto = d.produto
             CROSS JOIN lim
          WHERE d.data >= e.estreia_paginas AND d.data <= lim.dmax
        )
 SELECT produto,
    produto_ordem,
    estreia_paginas,
    min(data) AS de,
    max(data) AS ate,
    sum(sessoes) AS sessoes,
    sum(pedidos) AS pedidos,
    round(sum(receita), 2) AS receita,
    sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text) AS sessoes_pdp,
    sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text) AS pedidos_pdp,
    round(sum(receita) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text), 2) AS receita_pdp,
    round(100.0 * sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text), 0)::numeric, 2) AS conv_pdp,
    sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text) AS sessoes_lp,
    sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text) AS pedidos_lp,
    round(sum(receita) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text), 2) AS receita_lp,
    round(100.0 * sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text), 0)::numeric, 2) AS conv_lp,
    count(DISTINCT pagina_path) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text) AS qtd_paginas,
    round(100.0 * sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text), 0)::numeric - 100.0 * sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text), 0)::numeric, 2) AS dif_conv_pp,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text) < 300 THEN 'Amostra pequena'::text
            WHEN (sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'Pagina'::text), 0)::numeric) > (sum(pedidos) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessoes) FILTER (WHERE tipo = 'PDP'::text), 0)::numeric) THEN 'Pagina ganha'::text

create or replace view public.vw_site_tendencia_semana as
 WITH wk AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text))::date AS cur_week
        ), g AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_site_geral_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,

            sum(vw_site_geral_dia.unidades) AS unid,
            sum(vw_site_geral_dia.pedidos) AS ped,
            sum(vw_site_geral_dia.invest_ads) AS ads
           FROM vw_site_geral_dia
          WHERE vw_site_geral_dia.data >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '56 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_site_geral_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), fmt AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,
            sum(_src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.investimento) FILTER (WHERE _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.canal = 'Meta'::text) AS meta_c,
            sum(_src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.receita) FILTER (WHERE _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.canal = 'Meta'::text) AS meta_r,
            sum(_src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.investimento) FILTER (WHERE _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.canal = 'Google'::text) AS g_c,
            sum(_src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.receita) FILTER (WHERE _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.canal = 'Google'::text) AS g_r
           FROM _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia
          WHERE _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.data >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
                   FROM wk)) - '56 days'::interval)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, _src_site_ads_por_tipo_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        )
 SELECT to_char(g.semana::timestamp with time zone, 'DD/MM'::text) AS semana,
    g.semana AS semana_ini,
    g.semana = (( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk)) AS parcial,
    g.semana >= ((( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk)) - '14 days'::interval) AS ads_maturando,
    round(g.fat) AS faturamento,
    g.unid AS unidades,
    g.ped AS pedidos,
    round(g.ads) AS invest_ads,
    round(g.fat / NULLIF(g.ads, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_total,
    round(100.0 * g.ads / NULLIF(g.fat, 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos_pct,
    round(fmt.meta_r / NULLIF(fmt.meta_c, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_meta,
    round(fmt.g_r / NULLIF(fmt.g_c, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_google
   FROM g
     LEFT JOIN fmt ON fmt.semana = g.semana
  WHERE g.fat > 100000::numeric OR g.semana = (( SELECT wk.cur_week
           FROM wk))
  ORDER BY g.semana;

create or replace view public.vw_site_venda_midia_pedido as
 WITH cfg AS (
         SELECT config_atribuicao_site.inicio
           FROM config_atribuicao_site
          WHERE config_atribuicao_site.chave = 'shopify_ultimo_clique'::text
        ), o AS (
         SELECT s.date AS data,
            s.order_id,
            max(s.order_total_price) AS receita,
            max(lower(COALESCE(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_source, ''::text))) AS us,
            max(lower(COALESCE(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_medium, ''::text))) AS um,
            max(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_campaign) AS utm_campaign,
            max(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_content) AS utm_content
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item s
          WHERE COALESCE(s.order_test, false) = false AND s.order_cancelled_at IS NULL AND s.date >= (( SELECT cfg.inicio
                   FROM cfg))
          GROUP BY s.date, s.order_id
        ), c AS (
         SELECT o.data,
            o.order_id,
            o.receita,
            o.us,
            o.um,
            o.utm_campaign,
            o.utm_content,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.us = ANY (ARRAY['google'::text, 'google ads'::text])) AND o.um = 'cpc'::text THEN 'Google'::text
                    WHEN (o.us = ANY (ARRAY['facebook'::text, 'fb'::text, 'instagram'::text, 'ig'::text, 'meta'::text, 'meta ads'::text])) AND (o.um = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cpc'::text])) THEN 'Meta'::text
                    WHEN o.us = ''::text AND o.um = 'paid'::text THEN 'Meta'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS fonte
           FROM o
        )
 SELECT c.data,
    c.order_id,
    c.fonte,
    c.receita,
    c.utm_campaign,
    c.utm_content,
    COALESCE(gc.campaign_id, mc.campaign_id) AS campaign_id,
    COALESCE(gc.campaign_name, mc.campaign_name) AS campaign_name,
    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN c.fonte = 'Google'::text THEN gc.advertising_channel_type
            ELSE mc.objetivo
        END, 'UTM_SEM_CAMPANHA'::text) AS tipo_raw
   FROM c
     LEFT JOIN map_utm_campanha mp ON c.fonte = 'Google'::text AND mp.fonte = 'Google'::text AND mp.utm_campaign = c.utm_campaign
     LEFT JOIN dim_google_campanha gc ON gc.campaign_id = mp.campaign_id
     LEFT JOIN dim_meta_campanha mc ON c.fonte = 'Meta'::text AND mc.campaign_id = c.utm_campaign
  WHERE c.fonte IS NOT NULL;

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_ads_campanha_dia as

    round(sum(receita), 2) AS receita,
    sum(pedidos) AS pedidos,

            WHEN (sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(invest), 0::numeric)) >= 12::numeric AND sum(invest) >= 50::numeric THEN 'ESCALAR: ROAS acima de 12'::text

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_afiliado_dia as
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT f.order_id,
            COALESCE(f.order_dia, p.create_dia) AS data,
            p.total_amount AS gmv,
            abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric)) AS custo_afiliado,
            abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado_ads, 0::numeric)) AS custo_afiliado_ads,
            abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_parceiro, 0::numeric)) AS custo_parceiro,
            f.settlement,
            (abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric)) + abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado_ads, 0::numeric)) + abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_parceiro, 0::numeric))) > 0::numeric AS tem_afiliado
           FROM fact_tiktok_financeiro f
             JOIN tiktok_pedido p ON p.order_id = f.order_id
          WHERE p.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text
        )
 SELECT data,
    count(*) AS pedidos_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado) AS pedidos_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_pedidos_afiliado,
    round(sum(gmv), 2) AS gmv_total,
    round(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado), 2) AS gmv_afiliado,
    round(sum(custo_afiliado), 2) AS custo_afiliado,
    round(sum(custo_afiliado_ads), 2) AS custo_afiliado_ads,
    round(sum(custo_parceiro), 2) AS custo_parceiro,
    round(sum(custo_afiliado + custo_afiliado_ads + custo_parceiro), 2) AS custo_total,
    round(100.0 * sum(custo_afiliado + custo_afiliado_ads + custo_parceiro) / NULLIF(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado), 0::numeric), 2) AS comissao_efetiva_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(custo_afiliado + custo_afiliado_ads + custo_parceiro) / NULLIF(sum(gmv), 0::numeric), 2) AS custo_pct_gmv_total,
    round(avg(gmv) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado), 2) AS ticket_afiliado,
    round(avg(gmv) FILTER (WHERE NOT tem_afiliado), 2) AS ticket_sem_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * sum(settlement) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado) / NULLIF(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE tem_afiliado), 0::numeric), 2) AS margem_afiliado_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(settlement) FILTER (WHERE NOT tem_afiliado) / NULLIF(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE NOT tem_afiliado), 0::numeric), 2) AS margem_sem_afiliado_pct
   FROM base
  GROUP BY data;

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_afiliado_produto_dia as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT f.order_id,
            COALESCE(f.order_dia, p.create_dia) AS data,
            p.total_amount AS gmv_pedido,
            abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado, 0::numeric)) + abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_afiliado_ads, 0::numeric)) + abs(COALESCE(f.comissao_parceiro, 0::numeric)) AS custo_pedido
           FROM fact_tiktok_financeiro f
             JOIN tiktok_pedido p ON p.order_id = f.order_id
          WHERE p.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text
        ), item AS (
         SELECT pd.data,
            pd.order_id,
            pd.gmv_pedido,
            pd.custo_pedido,
            i.product_id,
            i.seller_sku,
            i.product_name,
            COALESCE(i.sale_price, 0::numeric) AS valor_item
           FROM ped pd
             JOIN tiktok_pedido_item i ON i.order_id = pd.order_id
        ), rateado AS (
         SELECT it.data,
            it.order_id,
            it.gmv_pedido,
            it.custo_pedido,
            it.product_id,
            it.seller_sku,
            it.product_name,
            it.valor_item,
            sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_id) AS valor_total_pedido,
                CASE
                    WHEN sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_id) > 0::numeric THEN it.custo_pedido * (it.valor_item / sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_id))
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS custo_rateado,
                CASE
                    WHEN sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_id) > 0::numeric THEN it.gmv_pedido * (it.valor_item / sum(it.valor_item) OVER (PARTITION BY it.order_id))
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS gmv_rateado
           FROM item it
        )
 SELECT data,
    seller_sku,
    max(product_name) AS produto,
    count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE custo_pedido > 0::numeric) AS pedidos_afiliado,
    count(DISTINCT order_id) AS pedidos_total,
    round(sum(gmv_rateado) FILTER (WHERE custo_pedido > 0::numeric), 2) AS gmv_afiliado,
    round(sum(gmv_rateado), 2) AS gmv_total,
    round(sum(custo_rateado), 2) AS custo_afiliado,
    round(100.0 * sum(custo_rateado) / NULLIF(sum(gmv_rateado) FILTER (WHERE custo_pedido > 0::numeric), 0::numeric), 2) AS comissao_efetiva_pct,
    round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE custo_pedido > 0::numeric)::numeric / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT order_id), 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_pedidos_via_afiliado
   FROM rateado
  GROUP BY data, seller_sku;

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_cadastro as

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_conteudo_dia as

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_criador as
 SELECT criador,
    count(*) AS videos,
    count(DISTINCT data) AS dias_ativos,
    sum(views) AS views,
    round(sum(gmv)) AS gmv,
    sum(sku_orders) AS pedidos,
    sum(unidades) AS unidades,
    round(sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric, 2) AS gpm,
    round(100::numeric * sum(ctr * views::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric, 2) AS ctr,
    max(data) AS ultimo_dia,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric) >= 500::numeric AND sum(views) >= 20000 THEN 'PARCEIRO CHAVE: alto GPM e alcance'::text
            WHEN (sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric) >= 500::numeric THEN 'ESCALAR: converte bem, falta alcance'::text

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_estoque as
 SELECT e.seller_sku,
    e.product_id,
    e.titulo,
    e.preco,
    e.quantidade,
    COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) AS vendas_28d,
    round(COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) / 28.0, 2) AS media_dia,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round(e.quantidade::numeric / (COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) / 28.0), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cobertura_dias,
        CASE
            WHEN e.quantidade = 0 AND COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN 'RUPTURADO: vende e esta zerado'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric THEN 'sem venda'::text
            WHEN (e.quantidade::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) / 28.0, 0::numeric)) < 7::numeric THEN 'CRITICO: menos de 7 dias'::text
            WHEN (e.quantidade::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) / 28.0, 0::numeric)) < 15::numeric THEN 'ATENCAO: menos de 15 dias'::text
            WHEN (e.quantidade::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(v.un_28d, 0::numeric) / 28.0, 0::numeric)) > 60::numeric THEN 'EXCEDENTE: mais de 60 dias'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS alerta
   FROM dim_tiktok_estoque e
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pi.seller_sku,
            count(*)::numeric AS un_28d
           FROM tiktok_pedido_item pi
             JOIN tiktok_pedido pd ON pd.order_id = pi.order_id
          WHERE pd.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text AND pi.create_dia >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 27)
          GROUP BY pi.seller_sku) v ON v.seller_sku = e.seller_sku
  WHERE e.seller_sku IS NOT NULL;

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_frete_dia as
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT p.create_dia AS data,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p.shipping_provider, ''::text), 'sem transportadora'::text) AS transportadora,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p.delivery_type, ''::text), 'nao informado'::text) AS tipo_entrega,

            p.order_id,
            p.status,
            p.total_amount,
            p.shipping_fee,
            p.shipping_fee_platform_discount
           FROM tiktok_pedido p
          WHERE COALESCE(p.is_sample_order, false) = false
        ), itens AS (
         SELECT b_1.data,
            b_1.transportadora,
            count(*) AS unidades,
            count(DISTINCT i_1.product_id) AS produtos
           FROM base b_1
             JOIN tiktok_pedido_item i_1 ON i_1.order_id = b_1.order_id
          WHERE b_1.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text
          GROUP BY b_1.data, b_1.transportadora
        ), fin AS (
         SELECT b_1.data,
            b_1.transportadora,
            round(sum(f_1.comissao_plataforma), 2) AS comissao,
            round(sum(f_1.comissao_afiliado), 2) AS afiliados,
            round(sum(f_1.frete_custo), 2) AS frete_custo,
            count(*) AS pedidos_com_financeiro
           FROM base b_1
             JOIN fact_tiktok_financeiro f_1 ON f_1.order_id = b_1.order_id
          GROUP BY b_1.data, b_1.transportadora
        )
 SELECT b.data,
    b.transportadora,
    max(b.tipo_entrega) AS tipo_entrega,
    max(b.fulfillment) AS fulfillment,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AS pedidos,
    COALESCE(i.unidades, 0::bigint) AS unidades,
    round(sum(b.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text), 2) AS receita,
    round(sum(b.shipping_fee) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text), 2) AS frete_cobrado,
    round(sum(b.shipping_fee_platform_discount) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text), 2) AS frete_subsidiado,
    round(avg(b.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text), 2) AS ticket_medio,
    round(sum(b.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text) / NULLIF(COALESCE(i.unidades, 0::bigint), 0)::numeric, 2) AS preco_medio,
    round(COALESCE(i.unidades, 0::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text), 0)::numeric, 2) AS unid_por_pedido,
    COALESCE(i.produtos, 0::bigint) AS produtos,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CANCELLED'::text) AS cancelados,
    round(sum(b.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CANCELLED'::text), 2) AS faturamento_cancelado,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CANCELLED'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 2) AS cancelamento_pct,
    f.comissao,
    f.afiliados,
    f.frete_custo,
    round(100.0 * COALESCE(f.pedidos_com_financeiro, 0::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 2) AS cobertura_financeiro_pct
   FROM base b
     LEFT JOIN itens i ON i.data = b.data AND i.transportadora = b.transportadora
     LEFT JOIN fin f ON f.data = b.data AND f.transportadora = b.transportadora
  GROUP BY b.data, b.transportadora, i.unidades, i.produtos, f.comissao, f.afiliados, f.frete_custo, f.pedidos_com_financeiro;

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_geral_dia as

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_margem_dia as
 SELECT f.statement_dia AS data,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    round(sum(p.total_amount)) AS receita_bruta,
    round(sum(f.receita_bruta)) AS receita_statement_api,
    round(sum(f.settlement)) AS settlement,
    round(sum(f.taxas_total)) AS taxas,
    round(sum(f.comissao_afiliado + f.comissao_afiliado_ads + f.comissao_parceiro)) AS comissao_afiliados,
    round(sum(f.comissao_plataforma)) AS comissao_plataforma,
    round(sum(f.imposto)) AS imposto,
    round(sum(f.reembolso)) AS reembolso,
    round(100.0 * sum(f.settlement) / NULLIF(sum(p.total_amount), 0::numeric), 1) AS margem_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(f.taxas_total) / NULLIF(sum(p.total_amount), 0::numeric), 1) AS taxa_pct,

create or replace view public.vw_tiktok_produto_dia as

create or replace view public.vw_ttk_ads_campanha as
 SELECT campaign_id,
    campanha,
    tipo,
    round(sum(invest)) AS invest,
    round(sum(receita)) AS receita,
    sum(pedidos) AS pedidos,
    round(sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(invest), 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(sum(invest) / NULLIF(sum(pedidos), 0::numeric), 2) AS custo_por_pedido,
        CASE
            WHEN sum(pedidos) = 0::numeric AND sum(invest) >= 100::numeric THEN 'CORTAR: gasto sem pedido'::text
            WHEN (sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(invest), 0::numeric)) < 7::numeric AND sum(invest) >= 500::numeric THEN 'REVISAR: ROAS baixo com verba relevante'::text
            WHEN (sum(receita) / NULLIF(sum(invest), 0::numeric)) >= 12::numeric AND sum(invest) >= 200::numeric THEN 'ESCALAR: ROAS alto'::text
            ELSE 'monitorar'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM vw_tiktok_ads_campanha_dia
  WHERE data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
  GROUP BY campaign_id, campanha, tipo
 HAVING sum(invest) > 0::numeric
  ORDER BY (sum(invest)) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_ttk_cancelamentos as
 SELECT COALESCE(ini, '(nao informado)'::text) AS iniciador,
    COALESCE(mot, '(sem motivo)'::text) AS motivo,
    pedidos,
    valor_perdido,
    round(100.0 * pedidos::numeric / sum(pedidos) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ini ~~* '%seller%'::text THEN 'ACAO INTERNA: cancelamento nosso, ver estoque e prazo'::text
            WHEN ini ~~* '%buyer%'::text THEN 'Comportamento do comprador: revisar expectativa e prazo'::text

            ELSE 'investigar'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM ( SELECT tiktok_pedido.cancellation_initiator AS ini,
            tiktok_pedido.cancel_reason AS mot,
            count(*) AS pedidos,
            round(sum(tiktok_pedido.total_amount)) AS valor_perdido

          WHERE tiktok_pedido.status = 'CANCELLED'::text AND tiktok_pedido.create_dia >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
          GROUP BY tiktok_pedido.cancellation_initiator, tiktok_pedido.cancel_reason

create or replace view public.vw_ttk_criadores_top as

    round(100::numeric * sum(ctr * views::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric, 2) AS ctr,

        CASE
            WHEN (sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric) >= 500::numeric AND sum(views) >= 20000 THEN 'PARCEIRO CHAVE: alto GPM e alcance'::text

 HAVING sum(gmv) > 0::numeric

create or replace view public.vw_ttk_produtos as
 SELECT p.produto_id,
    COALESCE(d.titulo, m.produto_nome, '(sem nome)'::text) AS produto,
    round(sum(p.gmv)) AS gmv,
    sum(p.pedidos) AS pedidos,
    sum(p.unidades) AS unidades,
    round(100::numeric * avg(p.ctr), 2) AS ctr,
    round(sum(p.gmv) / NULLIF(sum(p.unidades), 0)::numeric, 2) AS preco_medio,
    d.estoque_total,
    d.health,
        CASE
            WHEN d.product_id IS NULL THEN 'sem cadastro casado'::text
            WHEN d.estoque_total = 0 THEN 'RUPTURA: vende e esta zerado'::text
            WHEN d.health < 0.7 THEN 'MELHORAR CADASTRO: vende com ficha fraca'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM fact_tiktok_produto_perf_dia p
     LEFT JOIN dim_tiktok_produto d ON d.product_id = p.produto_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.produto_nome
           FROM fact_tiktok_video_dia v
          WHERE v.produto_id = p.produto_id
         LIMIT 1) m ON true
  WHERE p.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
  GROUP BY p.produto_id, d.titulo, m.produto_nome, d.product_id, d.estoque_total, d.health
  ORDER BY (sum(p.gmv)) DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_ttk_tendencia as
 SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week'::text, data::timestamp with time zone), 'YYYY-"S"IW'::text) AS semana,
    min(data) AS inicio,
    count(*) AS dias,
    round(sum(faturamento)) AS faturamento,
    sum(pedidos) AS pedidos,
    sum(unidades) AS unidades,
    round(sum(faturamento) / NULLIF(sum(pedidos), 0)::numeric, 2) AS ticket,
    round(100.0 * sum(pedidos_cancelados)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(pedidos) + sum(pedidos_cancelados), 0)::numeric, 1) AS cancelamento_pct,
    count(*) < 7 AS parcial,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) < 7 THEN 'semana parcial - nao comparar direto'::text
            ELSE 'semana completa'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM fact_tiktok_venda_dia
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, data::timestamp with time zone))
  ORDER BY (min(data));

create or replace view public.vw_ttk_videos_top as
 SELECT video_id,
    criador,
    "left"(titulo, 120) AS titulo,
    publicado_em::date AS publicado,
    sum(views) AS views,
    round(sum(gmv)) AS gmv,
    sum(unidades) AS unidades,
    round(sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric, 2) AS gpm,
    round(100::numeric * sum(ctr * views::numeric) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric, 2) AS ctr,
    max(produto_nome) AS produto,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric) >= 500::numeric AND sum(views) >= 5000 THEN 'ESCALAR: GPM alto com volume'::text
            WHEN (sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric) >= 500::numeric THEN 'IMPULSIONAR: converte, falta alcance'::text
            WHEN sum(views) >= 50000 AND (sum(gmv) / NULLIF(sum(views), 0)::numeric * 1000::numeric) < 100::numeric THEN 'REVISAR: alcance sem venda'::text
            ELSE 'monitorar'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM fact_tiktok_video_dia
  WHERE data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
  GROUP BY video_id, criador, ("left"(titulo, 120)), (publicado_em::date)
 HAVING sum(gmv) > 0::numeric
  ORDER BY (sum(gmv)) DESC
 LIMIT 80;

create or replace view public.vw_up_afiliado as
 WITH af AS (
         SELECT a.id,
            a.nome,
            a.programa,
            a.programa_id,
            a.status,
            upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.c)) AS cupom
           FROM uppromote_afiliado a,
            LATERAL unnest(a.cupons) c(c)
          WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(c.c, ''::text)) <> ''::text
        ), rec AS (
         SELECT upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM vw_site_cupom_dia.cupom)) AS cupom,
            sum(vw_site_cupom_dia.faturamento_liquido) AS receita
           FROM vw_site_cupom_dia
          GROUP BY (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM vw_site_cupom_dia.cupom)))
        )
 SELECT af.id AS uppromote_id,
    max(af.nome) AS nome,
    max(af.programa) AS programa,
    max(af.programa_id) AS programa_id,
    max(af.status) AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN max(af.programa) ~~* '%Influenciador%'::text THEN 'influenciador'::text
            WHEN max(af.programa) ~~* '%Connect%'::text THEN 'profissional'::text
            ELSE 'afiliado'::text
        END AS tipo,
        CASE
            WHEN max(af.programa) ~~* '%10%%'::text THEN 10
            WHEN max(af.programa) ~~* '%5%%'::text THEN 5
            WHEN max(af.programa) ~~* '%7%%'::text THEN 7
            ELSE 0
        END::numeric AS comissao_pct,
    (array_agg(af.cupom ORDER BY (COALESCE(rec.receita, 0::numeric)) DESC))[1] AS cupom,
    count(*) AS cupons,
    COALESCE(sum(rec.receita), 0::numeric) AS receita_total
   FROM af
     LEFT JOIN rec ON rec.cupom = af.cupom
  GROUP BY af.id;

create or replace view public.vw_vg_kpis as
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT sum(tab_ml_kpi_dia.pedidos) AS ped,
            sum(tab_ml_kpi_dia.unidades) AS un,
            sum(tab_ml_kpi_dia.faturamento) AS fat,
            sum(tab_ml_kpi_dia.comissao) AS com,
            sum(tab_ml_kpi_dia.invest_display + tab_ml_kpi_dia.invest_brand + tab_ml_kpi_dia.invest_pads) AS ads_tot
           FROM tab_ml_kpi_dia
          WHERE tab_ml_kpi_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT base.ped,
            base.un,
            base.fat,
            base.com,
            base.ads_tot,
            round(base.ads_tot / NULLIF(base.fat, 0::numeric) * 100::numeric, 1) AS tacos,
            round(base.fat / NULLIF(base.ads_tot, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas_total
           FROM base
        )
 SELECT ord,
    metrica,
    valor,
    meta,
    sugestao
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS ord,
            'Faturamento'::text AS metrica,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(calc.fat), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS valor,
            NULL::text AS meta,
            'Base do canal'::text AS sugestao
           FROM calc
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 2,
            'Pedidos'::text,
            replace(to_char(calc.ped, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS replace,
            NULL::text,
            'Volume de pedidos'::text
           FROM calc
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 3,
            'Unidades'::text,
            replace(to_char(calc.un, 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text) AS replace,
            NULL::text,
            'Unidades vendidas'::text
           FROM calc
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 4,
            'Ticket medio'::text,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(calc.fat / NULLIF(calc.ped, 0::numeric), 2), 'FM990.00'::text), '.'::text, ','::text),
            NULL::text,
            'Faturamento por pedido'::text
           FROM calc
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 5,
            'Comissao ML'::text,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(calc.com), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text),
            NULL::text,
            'Custo de comissao'::text
           FROM calc
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 6,
            'Investimento ads'::text,
            'R$ '::text || replace(to_char(round(calc.ads_tot), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text),
            'R$ 996.087'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN calc.ads_tot > 996087::numeric THEN ('Reduzir ~R$'::text || replace(to_char(round(calc.ads_tot - 996087::numeric), 'FM999,999,999'::text), ','::text, '.'::text)) || ' para TACoS 10%'::text
                    ELSE 'Dentro do teto'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM calc

create or replace view public.vw_vg_produtos as
 WITH v AS (
         SELECT a.item_id,

            sum(a.pedidos) AS ped,
            sum(a.faturamento) AS fat,
            sum(a.visitas) AS vis
           FROM vw_ml_anuncio_dia a
          WHERE a.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 29)
          GROUP BY a.item_id
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT sum(v_1.fat) AS t
           FROM v v_1
        )
 SELECT i.title AS produto,
    v.unid AS unidades,
    v.ped AS pedidos,
    round(v.fat) AS faturamento,
    round(100::numeric * v.fat / NULLIF(( SELECT tot.t
           FROM tot), 0::numeric), 1) AS pct_total,
    round(v.fat / NULLIF(v.ped, 0::numeric), 2) AS ticket,
    round(100.0 * v.ped / NULLIF(v.vis, 0::numeric), 1) AS conversao_pct,
    COALESCE(c.status, '-'::text) AS buybox,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.status = ANY (ARRAY['competing'::text, 'sharing_first_place'::text])) AND c.current_price > (c.price_to_win * 1.05) THEN ('Ajustar preco p/ buy box (preco '::text || round(100::numeric * (c.current_price - c.price_to_win) / NULLIF(c.price_to_win, 0::numeric))) || '% acima do necessario)'::text
            WHEN v.vis > 1000::numeric AND (100.0 * v.ped / NULLIF(v.vis, 0::numeric)) < 5::numeric THEN ((('Revisar listagem: '::text || v.vis) || ' visitas convertendo '::text) || round(100.0 * v.ped / NULLIF(v.vis, 0::numeric), 1)) || '%'::text
            WHEN i.logistic_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'fulfillment'::text THEN 'Avaliar enviar ao Full (melhora ranking)'::text
            WHEN v.fat >= (0.05 * (( SELECT tot.t
               FROM tot))) THEN 'Carro-chefe: proteger estoque e buy box'::text
            ELSE 'Manter'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM v
     JOIN ml_item i ON i.item_id = v.item_id
     LEFT JOIN ml_item_competicao c ON c.item_id = v.item_id
  ORDER BY v.fat DESC;

create or replace view public.vw_vg_tendencia as
 WITH w AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, vw_ml_anuncio_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS semana,
            sum(vw_ml_anuncio_dia.faturamento) AS fat,
            sum(vw_ml_anuncio_dia.pedidos) AS ped,
            sum(vw_ml_anuncio_dia.unidades) AS un
           FROM vw_ml_anuncio_dia
          WHERE vw_ml_anuncio_dia.data >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'::text)::date - 55)
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, vw_ml_anuncio_dia.data::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        )
 SELECT semana,
    round(fat) AS faturamento,
    ped AS pedidos,
    un AS unidades,
        CASE
            WHEN lag(fat) OVER (ORDER BY semana) IS NULL THEN 'Semana base'::text
            WHEN fat > lag(fat) OVER (ORDER BY semana) THEN 'Faturamento subindo vs semana anterior'::text
            ELSE 'Faturamento caindo vs semana anterior'::text
        END AS sugestao
   FROM w
  ORDER BY semana;

create or replace view public.vw_visao_geral_dia as
 WITH corte AS (
         SELECT CURRENT_DATE - 2 AS c
        ), venda AS (
         SELECT f.data,
            f.venda_bruta AS venda_total,
            f.venda_liquida AS venda_total_paga,
            f.pedidos::bigint AS pedidos_total,
            f.unidades::bigint AS unidades_vendidas
           FROM fact_venda_dia f,
            corte
          WHERE f.data < corte.c
        UNION ALL
         SELECT r.data_venda AS data,
            round(sum(r.total_amount), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(r.paid_amount), 2) AS round,
            count(*) AS count,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(i.quantity), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM ml_pedido_item_rt i
                  WHERE i.data_venda = r.data_venda) AS "coalesce"
           FROM ml_pedido_rt r,
            corte
          WHERE r.status = 'paid'::text AND r.data_venda >= corte.c
          GROUP BY r.data_venda
        ), ads AS (
         SELECT vw_ads_por_tipo_dia.data,
            sum(vw_ads_por_tipo_dia.investimento) AS invest_ads,
            sum(vw_ads_por_tipo_dia.receita) AS receita_ads,
            sum(vw_ads_por_tipo_dia.impressoes) AS impressoes_ads,
            sum(vw_ads_por_tipo_dia.cliques) AS cliques_ads
           FROM vw_ads_por_tipo_dia
          GROUP BY vw_ads_por_tipo_dia.data
        ), vis AS (
         SELECT ml_item_visitas_dia.data,
            sum(ml_item_visitas_dia.visitas) AS visitas
           FROM ml_item_visitas_dia
          GROUP BY ml_item_visitas_dia.data
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(v.data, a.data, vi.data) AS data,
    v.venda_total,
    v.venda_total_paga,
    v.pedidos_total,
    v.unidades_vendidas,
    a.invest_ads,
    a.receita_ads,
    a.impressoes_ads,
    a.cliques_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN v.venda_total > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * a.receita_ads / v.venda_total, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS share_ads_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN a.invest_ads > 0::numeric THEN round(a.receita_ads / a.invest_ads, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN a.invest_ads > 0::numeric THEN round(v.venda_total / a.invest_ads, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas_total,
        CASE
            WHEN a.receita_ads > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * a.invest_ads / a.receita_ads, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS acos_ads,
        CASE
            WHEN v.venda_total > 0::numeric THEN round(100.0 * a.invest_ads / v.venda_total, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS acos_total,
    vi.visitas,
        CASE
            WHEN vi.visitas > 0 THEN round(100.0 * v.unidades_vendidas::numeric / vi.visitas::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS conversao_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN v.pedidos_total > 0 THEN round(v.venda_total / v.pedidos_total::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ticket_medio
   FROM venda v
     FULL JOIN ads a ON a.data = v.data
     FULL JOIN vis vi ON vi.data = COALESCE(v.data, a.data);
